```js
/**
 * BigQuery weapon — queries Google BigQuery via the REST API v2 (jobs.query).
 * Auth: GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT in profiles.env_vars (service account JSON), falls back to process.env.
 */

export const toc = {
  searchDatasets: "Search BigQuery datasets available to the service account.",
  readRecentEvents: "Read the most recent rows from a BigQuery table.",
  runQuery: "Run an arbitrary StandardSQL query and return rows.",
  insertRows: "Stream-insert rows into a BigQuery table via tabledata.insertAll.",
};
import { getGoogleCredentials } from "@/libs/council/profileEnvVars";

const BIGQUERY_API = "https://bigquery.googleapis.com/bigquery/v2";
const TOKEN_URL = "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token";

async function resolveUserId(explicit) {
  if (explicit) return explicit;
  try {
    const { getAdventurerExecutionUserId } = await import("@/libs/adventurer/advance.js");
    const ctxId = getAdventurerExecutionUserId();
    if (ctxId) return ctxId;
  } catch { /* not in adventurer context */ }
  const { requireUser } = await import("@/libs/council/auth/server");
  const user = await requireUser();
  return user.id;
}

async function getServiceAccountKey(userId) {
  const creds = await getGoogleCredentials(userId);
  const raw = creds.serviceAccountJson;
  if (!raw) throw new Error("GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT is not set in profiles.env_vars or process.env.");
  const key = typeof raw === "string" ? JSON.parse(raw) : raw;
  if (!key.client_email || !key.private_key) {
    throw new Error("GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT missing client_email or private_key.");
  }
  return key;
}

/**
 * Build a signed JWT and exchange it for a BigQuery access token.
 * @param {string} userId
 * @returns {Promise<string>}
 */
async function getAccessToken(userId, scope = "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/bigquery.readonly") {
  const key = await getServiceAccountKey(userId);
  const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
  const header = { alg: "RS256", typ: "JWT" };
  const payload = {
    iss: key.client_email,
    scope,
    aud: key.token_uri || TOKEN_URL,
    iat: now,
    exp: now + 3600,
  };

  const enc = (obj) => Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(obj)).toString("base64url");
  const unsigned = `${enc(header)}.${enc(payload)}`;

  const crypto = await import("node:crypto");
  const sign = crypto.createSign("RSA-SHA256");
  sign.update(unsigned);
  const signature = sign.sign(key.private_key, "base64url");
  const jwt = `${unsigned}.${signature}`;

  const res = await fetch(key.token_uri || TOKEN_URL, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
    body: `grant_type=urn%3Aietf%3Aparams%3Aoauth%3Agrant-type%3Ajwt-bearer&assertion=${jwt}`,
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    const text = await res.text();
    throw new Error(`Token exchange failed (${res.status}): ${text}`);
  }
  const data = await res.json();
  return data.access_token;
}

async function getProjectId(userId) {
  const key = await getServiceAccountKey(userId);
  return key.project_id || "";
}

/**
 * List datasets in the project.
 * @param {string} [userId]
 * @returns {Promise<Array<{ datasetId: string, location: string }>>}
 */
export async function searchDatasets(userId) {
  const uid = await resolveUserId(userId);
  const token = await getAccessToken(uid);
  const projectId = await getProjectId(uid);
  if (!projectId) throw new Error("project_id missing from service account key.");

  const res = await fetch(`${BIGQUERY_API}/projects/${projectId}/datasets`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    const text = await res.text();
    throw new Error(`searchDatasets failed (${res.status}): ${text}`);
  }
  const body = await res.json();
  return (body.datasets || []).map((d) => ({
    datasetId: d.datasetReference?.datasetId || "",
    location: d.location || "",
  }));
}

/**
 * Query recent events from a table using jobs.query.
 * @param {string} datasetId
 * @param {string} tableId
 * @param {number} [limit=10]
 * @param {string} [userId]
 * @returns {Promise<{ rows: Array<Record<string, unknown>> }>}
 */
export async function readRecentEvents(datasetId, tableId, limit = 10, userId) {
  if (!datasetId || !tableId) throw new Error("datasetId and tableId are required.");
  const uid = await resolveUserId(userId);
  const token = await getAccessToken(uid);
  const projectId = await getProjectId(uid);
  if (!projectId) throw new Error("project_id missing from service account key.");

  const n = Math.max(1, Math.min(Number(limit) || 10, 1000));
  const query = `SELECT * FROM \`${projectId}.${datasetId}.${tableId}\` ORDER BY _PARTITIONTIME DESC LIMIT ${n}`;

  const res = await fetch(`${BIGQUERY_API}/projects/${projectId}/jobs`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ configuration: { query: { query, useLegacySql: false } } }),
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    const text = await res.text();
    throw new Error(`BigQuery jobs.query failed (${res.status}): ${text}`);
  }
  const job = await res.json();
  const jobId = job.jobReference?.jobId;
  if (!jobId) throw new Error("No jobId returned from BigQuery.");

  let status = job.status?.state;
  while (status !== "DONE") {
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1000));
    const pollRes = await fetch(`${BIGQUERY_API}/projects/${projectId}/jobs/${jobId}`, {
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
    });
    if (!pollRes.ok) {
      const text = await pollRes.text();
      throw new Error(`BigQuery job poll failed (${pollRes.status}): ${text}`);
    }
    const pollData = await pollRes.json();
    status = pollData.status?.state;
    if (pollData.status?.errorResult) {
      throw new Error(`BigQuery job error: ${JSON.stringify(pollData.status.errorResult)}`);
    }
  }

  const resultsRes = await fetch(
    `${BIGQUERY_API}/projects/${projectId}/jobs/${jobId}/getQueryResults?maxResults=${n}`,
    { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } },
  );
  if (!resultsRes.ok) {
    const text = await resultsRes.text();
    throw new Error(`BigQuery getQueryResults failed (${resultsRes.status}): ${text}`);
  }
  const resultsData = await resultsRes.json();
  const fields = (resultsData.schema?.fields || []).map((f) => f.name);
  const rows = (resultsData.rows || []).map((row) => {
    const obj = {};
    (row.f || []).forEach((cell, i) => { obj[fields[i] || `col_${i}`] = cell.v; });
    return obj;
  });
  return { rows };
}

/**
 * Run an arbitrary StandardSQL query against the project. Polls the job to
 * completion and pages through results up to maxResults rows.
 *
 * @param {{ query: string, maxResults?: number, userId?: string }} params
 * @returns {Promise<{ rows: Array<Record<string, unknown>>, schema: Array<{name:string,type:string}>, totalRows: number }>}
 */
export async function runQuery({ query, maxResults = 5000, userId } = {}) {
  if (!query || typeof query !== "string") throw new Error("query is required.");
  const uid = await resolveUserId(userId);
  // Running a query creates a job via jobs.insert, which the read-only scope does
  // NOT authorize (403 ACCESS_TOKEN_SCOPE_INSUFFICIENT). Request the full bigquery
  // scope — query results are still bounded by the SA's dataset-level IAM grants.
  const token = await getAccessToken(uid, "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/bigquery");
  const projectId = await getProjectId(uid);
  if (!projectId) throw new Error("project_id missing from service account key.");

  const cap = Math.max(1, Math.min(Number(maxResults) || 5000, 50000));

  // Use the SYNCHRONOUS jobs.query endpoint (POST /queries) rather than
  // jobs.insert + getQueryResults. The async path's getQueryResults call returns
  // an HTML 404 from Google's frontend (not a JSON API error) even with the
  // correct location echoed back — a routing quirk that made runQuery unusable.
  // jobs.query returns the first page of rows inline; we page the remainder with
  // getQueryResults ONLY if jobComplete and a pageToken is present, threading the
  // location the response reports.
  const queryRes = await fetch(`${BIGQUERY_API}/projects/${projectId}/queries`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      query,
      useLegacySql: false,
      maxResults: Math.min(1000, cap),
      timeoutMs: 60000,
    }),
  });
  if (!queryRes.ok) {
    const text = await queryRes.text();
    throw new Error(`BigQuery jobs.query failed (${queryRes.status}): ${text}`);
  }
  const first = await queryRes.json();
  const jobId = first.jobReference?.jobId;
  const location = first.jobReference?.location || "";
  const locParam = (u) => { if (location) u.searchParams.set("location", location); };

  const rows = [];
  let schemaFields = (first.schema?.fields || []).map((f) => ({ name: f.name, type: f.type }));
  let totalRows = Number(first.totalRows || 0);
  const collect = (data) => {
    if (!schemaFields.length) {
      schemaFields = (data.schema?.fields || []).map((f) => ({ name: f.name, type: f.type }));
    }
    const fields = schemaFields.map((f) => f.name);
    for (const row of data.rows || []) {
      const obj = {};
      (row.f || []).forEach((cell, i) => { obj[fields[i] || `col_${i}`] = cell.v; });
      rows.push(obj);
      if (rows.length >= cap) break;
    }
  };
  collect(first);

  let pageToken = first.pageToken || "";
  let complete = first.jobComplete !== false;
  // If the query didn't finish within timeoutMs, poll via getQueryResults until done.
  while ((!complete || (pageToken && rows.length < cap)) && jobId) {
    const url = new URL(`${BIGQUERY_API}/projects/${projectId}/jobs/${jobId}/getQueryResults`);
    url.searchParams.set("maxResults", String(Math.min(1000, cap - rows.length)));
    url.searchParams.set("timeoutMs", "60000");
    locParam(url);
    if (pageToken) url.searchParams.set("pageToken", pageToken);
    const resultsRes = await fetch(url, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });
    if (!resultsRes.ok) {
      const text = await resultsRes.text();
      throw new Error(`BigQuery getQueryResults failed (${resultsRes.status}): ${text}`);
    }
    const data = await resultsRes.json();
    complete = data.jobComplete !== false;
    totalRows = Number(data.totalRows || totalRows);
    if (complete) collect(data);
    pageToken = data.pageToken || "";
    if (!pageToken && complete) break;
  }

  return { rows, schema: schemaFields, totalRows };
}

/**
 * Stream-insert rows into a BigQuery table.
 * @param {{ datasetId: string, tableId: string, rows: Array<{insertId?: string, json: Record<string, unknown>}>, userId?: string }} params
 * @returns {Promise<{ inserted: number, errors: Array<{index: number, errors: unknown}> }>}
 */
export async function insertRows({ datasetId, tableId, rows, userId }) {
  if (!datasetId || !tableId) throw new Error("datasetId and tableId are required.");
  if (!Array.isArray(rows) || rows.length === 0) return { inserted: 0, errors: [] };
  const uid = await resolveUserId(userId);
  const token = await getAccessToken(uid, "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/bigquery");
  const projectId = await getProjectId(uid);

  const res = await fetch(
    `${BIGQUERY_API}/projects/${projectId}/datasets/${datasetId}/tables/${tableId}/insertAll`,
    {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ rows, skipInvalidRows: false, ignoreUnknownValues: false }),
    },
  );
  if (!res.ok) {
    const text = await res.text();
    throw new Error(`insertAll failed (${res.status}): ${text}`);
  }
  const body = await res.json();
  const errors = (body.insertErrors || []).map((e) => ({ index: e.index, errors: e.errors }));
  return { inserted: rows.length - errors.length, errors };
}

/**
 * Check whether Google service account credentials are available.
 * @param {string} [userId]
 */
export async function checkCredentials(userId) {
  try {
    const uid = await resolveUserId(userId);
    const creds = await getGoogleCredentials(uid);
    if (!creds.serviceAccountJson) return { ok: false, projectId: "" };
    const key = typeof creds.serviceAccountJson === "string"
      ? JSON.parse(creds.serviceAccountJson)
      : creds.serviceAccountJson;
    return { ok: true, projectId: key.project_id || "" };
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, projectId: "" };
  }
}
```

```js
/**
 * Bioinvsync weapon — SSH/SFTP access to the <REDACTED-HOST> legacy server.
 *
 * Connection details are redacted from source and read from env (set in the
 * gitignored .env.local; see .env.example for the var list):
 *   BIOINVSYNC_HOST, BIOINVSYNC_PORT, BIOINVSYNC_USER, BIOINVSYNC_KEY_FILE
 *
 * Uses plink.exe (PuTTY) which reads .ppk natively.
 * Requires Pageant to be running with the key loaded for non-interactive use.
 * Start Pageant: <PuTTY>\pageant.exe <BIOINVSYNC_KEY_FILE>
 */

export const toc = {
  executeCommand: "Execute a shell command on the bioinvsync host over SSH.",
  readRemoteFile: "Read a file from the bioinvsync host.",
  searchFiles: "Search files on the bioinvsync host.",
};
import { execFile } from "node:child_process";
import { promisify } from "node:util";

const execFileAsync = promisify(execFile);

// Redacted from source — real values live in the gitignored .env.local.
const HOST = process.env.BIOINVSYNC_HOST;
const PORT = process.env.BIOINVSYNC_PORT || "2223";
const USER = process.env.BIOINVSYNC_USER;
const KEY_FILE = process.env.BIOINVSYNC_KEY_FILE;
const PLINK = process.env.PUTTY_PLINK || "C:\\Program Files\\PuTTY\\plink.exe";
const DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 30_000;

function requireConn() {
  const missing = [
    ["BIOINVSYNC_HOST", HOST],
    ["BIOINVSYNC_USER", USER],
    ["BIOINVSYNC_KEY_FILE", KEY_FILE],
  ].filter(([, v]) => !v).map(([k]) => k);
  if (missing.length) {
    throw new Error(
      `bioinvsync connection not configured — set ${missing.join(", ")} in .env.local (see .env.example)`
    );
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Helpers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

async function isPageantRunning() {
  try {
    const { stdout } = await execFileAsync("tasklist", [], { timeout: 5000 });
    return stdout.toLowerCase().includes("pageant");
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Actions
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/**
 * Execute a command on the bioinvsync server via SSH.
 * @param {{ command: string, timeout?: number }} input
 */
export async function executeCommand({ command, timeout } = {}) {
  if (!command) throw new Error('"command" is required');
  requireConn();

  const pageant = await isPageantRunning();
  if (!pageant) {
    throw new Error(
      "Pageant is not running. Start it with the bioinvsync key loaded:\n" +
      `"${PLINK.replace(/plink\.exe$/i, "pageant.exe")}" "${KEY_FILE}"`
    );
  }

  const args = [
    "-ssh",
    "-P", PORT,
    "-i", KEY_FILE,
    "-batch",
    `${USER}@${HOST}`,
    command,
  ];

  try {
    const { stdout, stderr } = await execFileAsync(PLINK, args, {
      timeout: timeout ?? DEFAULT_TIMEOUT,
      maxBuffer: 5 * 1024 * 1024,
    });
    return { ok: true, stdout: stdout.slice(0, 10000), stderr: stderr.slice(0, 2000) };
  } catch (e) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      stdout: (e.stdout || "").slice(0, 10000),
      stderr: (e.stderr || e.message || "").slice(0, 2000),
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Read a file from the bioinvsync server.
 * @param {{ path: string, tail?: number }} input
 */
export async function readRemoteFile({ path, tail } = {}) {
  if (!path) throw new Error('"path" is required');
  const cmd = tail ? `tail -n ${tail} '${path}'` : `cat '${path}'`;
  return executeCommand({ command: cmd });
}

/**
 * List directory contents on the bioinvsync server.
 * @param {{ path?: string }} input
 */
export async function searchFiles({ path } = {}) {
  const target = path || `/home/${USER}/public_html`;
  return executeCommand({ command: `find '${target}' -maxdepth 2 -type f | sort` });
}

/**
 * Check connectivity and Pageant status.
 */
export async function checkCredentials() {
  const pageant = await isPageantRunning();
  if (!pageant) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      msg: "Pageant not running. Start it with the bioinvsync key (BIOINVSYNC_KEY_FILE) to enable SSH access.",
    };
  }
  const result = await executeCommand({ command: "echo connected && hostname", timeout: 10000 });
  return {
    ok: result.ok,
    msg: result.ok ? `Connected: ${result.stdout.trim()}` : result.stderr,
  };
}
```

```js
/**
 * Biomarker Hydration Weapon
 *
 * Zero-LLM, script-only Phase 1.
 * Fetches and parses structured gene data from external APIs and Boster catalog scraping.
 *
 * Primary export: hydrateAll(slugs, biomarker, urlMap) → { [slug]: value }
 *
 * urlMap keys:
 *   uniprot        — UniProt REST JSON endpoint, e.g. https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q8WXS8.json
 *   proteinatlas   — Human-readable Protein Atlas URL (browseable), e.g. https://www.proteinatlas.org/ENSG00000138316-ADAMTS14
 *                    NOTE: The .json endpoint pattern is an SPA and does NOT return JSON. Tissue data
 *                    is fetched internally via the search_download API using the biomarker gene symbol.
 *   boster_gene_card — Boster gene info card URL, e.g. https://www.bosterbio.com/bosterbio-gene-info-cards/ADAMTS14
 *
 * Slug source map:
 *   uniprot:      gene_symbol, gene_full_name, gene_aliases, protein_superfamily, uniprot_id,
 *                 wb_predicted_mw_kda, signal_peptide_range, ptm_glycosylation_sites,
 *                 domain_list, subcellular_localization, isoform_count
 *   proteinatlas: tissue_high, tissue_med, tissue_low (via search_download API + gzip)
 *   boster:       wb_image_url, ihc_image_url, main_wb_antibody_sku, wb_antibody_citations,
 *                 wb_antibody_url, pub_count, assay_apps
 *   computed:     uniprot_url, proteinatlas_url, boster_gene_url
 */

import { gunzipSync } from 'zlib';

// ── Source registry ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const SLUG_REGISTRY = {
  // Script-hydratable — UniProt
  gene_symbol:             { source: 'uniprot',      desc: 'HGNC gene symbol from UniProt genes entry' },
  gene_full_name:          { source: 'uniprot',      desc: 'Full recommended protein name from UniProt' },
  gene_aliases:            { source: 'uniprot',      desc: 'Gene synonyms and ORF names joined by ·' },
  protein_superfamily:     { source: 'uniprot',      desc: 'Protein family from UniProt similarity comment or keyword' },
  uniprot_id:              { source: 'uniprot',      desc: 'Primary UniProt accession number' },
  wb_predicted_mw_kda:     { source: 'uniprot',      desc: 'Predicted MW in kDa from UniProt sequence mass (rounded)' },
  signal_peptide_range:    { source: 'uniprot',      desc: 'Signal peptide residue start–end from UniProt features' },
  ptm_glycosylation_sites: { source: 'uniprot',      desc: 'N/O-glycosylation sites from UniProt PTM annotations' },
  domain_list:             { source: 'uniprot',      desc: 'Domain names from UniProt feature annotations' },
  subcellular_localization:{ source: 'uniprot',      desc: 'Subcellular location string from UniProt comment' },
  isoform_count:           { source: 'uniprot',      desc: 'Number of annotated isoforms from UniProt alternative products' },

  // Script-hydratable — Protein Atlas
  tissue_high: { source: 'proteinatlas', desc: 'Tissues with high protein expression (Protein Atlas)' },
  tissue_med:  { source: 'proteinatlas', desc: 'Tissues with medium protein expression (Protein Atlas)' },
  tissue_low:  { source: 'proteinatlas', desc: 'Tissues with low protein expression (Protein Atlas)' },

  // Script-hydratable — Boster catalog scraping
  wb_image_url:          { source: 'boster', desc: 'WB blot image URL scraped from Boster gene card' },
  ihc_image_url:         { source: 'boster', desc: 'IHC image URL scraped from Boster gene card' },

// ── Internal fetch helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
async function _fetchJson(url, label) {
  const res = await fetch(url, {
    headers: {
      Accept: 'application/json',
      'User-Agent': 'BosterBio-ContentPipeline/1.0 (bosterbio.com)',
    },
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`${label} HTTP ${res.status} — ${url}`);
  return res.json();
}

/**
 * Fetch tissue expression data from Protein Atlas search download API.
 * PA's ENSG-GENE.json URL pattern serves SPA HTML, not JSON — use this instead.
 * Returns the parsed JSON entry object for the first gene match, or throws.
 */
async function _fetchProteinAtlasTissue(biomarker) {
  const url = `https://www.proteinatlas.org/api/search_download.php?search=${encodeURIComponent(biomarker)}&format=json&columns=g,eg,rnats,rnatsm`;
  const res = await fetch(url, {
    headers: { 'User-Agent': 'BosterBio-ContentPipeline/1.0 (bosterbio.com)' },
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`ProteinAtlas search API HTTP ${res.status}`);
  // Response is raw gzip — decompress with Node zlib
  const buf = Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer());
  const decompressed = gunzipSync(buf);
  const entries = JSON.parse(decompressed.toString('utf8'));
  if (!Array.isArray(entries) || entries.length === 0) throw new Error('No Protein Atlas entry for gene');
  return entries[0];
}

async function _fetchHtml(url) {
  const res = await fetch(url, {
    headers: {
      'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/120 Safari/537.36',
      Accept: 'text/html,application/xhtml+xml',
    },
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Boster HTML fetch HTTP ${res.status} — ${url}`);
  return res.text();
}

// ── UniProt field resolvers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function _fromUniProt(slug, data) {
  switch (slug) {
    case 'gene_symbol':
      return data.genes?.[0]?.geneName?.value ?? data.primaryAccession ?? '';

    case 'gene_full_name': {
      const rec = data.proteinDescription?.recommendedName?.fullName?.value;
      if (rec) return rec;
      return data.proteinDescription?.submittedNames?.[0]?.fullName?.value ?? '';
    }

    case 'gene_aliases': {
      const synonyms = (data.genes?.[0]?.synonyms ?? []).map(s => s.value);
      const orf = (data.genes?.[0]?.orfNames ?? []).map(o => o.value);
      return [...synonyms, ...orf].join(' · ') || '(no aliases listed)';
    }

    case 'protein_superfamily': {
      const sim = data.comments?.find(c => c.commentType === 'SIMILARITY');
      if (sim?.texts?.[0]?.value) {
        return sim.texts[0].value.replace(/^Belongs to the /, '').replace(/\.$/, '');
      }
      const kw = data.keywords?.find(k => k.category === 'Family & Domains');
      return kw?.name ?? '(family not annotated)';
    }

    case 'uniprot_id':
      return data.primaryAccession ?? '';

    case 'wb_predicted_mw_kda': {
      const mw = data.sequence?.molWeight;
      return mw ? String(Math.round(mw / 1000)) : 'N/A';
    }

    case 'signal_peptide_range': {
      const sp = data.features?.find(
        f => f.type === 'Signal' || f.type === 'signal peptide' ||
             (typeof f.type === 'string' && f.type.toLowerCase().includes('signal'))
      );
      if (!sp) return 'No signal peptide annotated';
      const s = sp.location?.start?.value ?? '?';
      const e = sp.location?.end?.value ?? '?';
      return `Residues ${s}–${e}`;
    }

    case 'ptm_glycosylation_sites': {
      const sites = (data.features ?? []).filter(f =>
        f.type === 'Glycosylation' ||
        (typeof f.type === 'string' && f.type.toLowerCase().includes('glycosy'))
      );
      if (!sites.length) return 'No glycosylation sites annotated in UniProt';
      return sites.slice(0, 5).map(s => {
        const pos = s.location?.position?.value ?? s.location?.start?.value ?? '?';
        const desc = s.description ?? s.type ?? 'Glycosylation';
        return `${desc} at position ${pos}`;
      }).join('; ');
    }

    case 'domain_list': {
      const domains = (data.features ?? []).filter(f =>
        f.type === 'Domain' || (typeof f.type === 'string' && f.type.toLowerCase() === 'domain')
      );
      if (!domains.length) return 'No domains annotated';
      return domains.map(d => d.description ?? d.name ?? 'unnamed').join(', ');
    }

    case 'subcellular_localization': {
      const loc = data.comments?.find(c => c.commentType === 'SUBCELLULAR LOCATION');
      if (!loc) return 'Unknown';
      const locs = (loc.subcellularLocations ?? [])
        .map(l => l.location?.value).filter(Boolean);
      return locs.join(', ') || 'Unknown';
    }

    case 'isoform_count': {
      const ap = data.comments?.find(c => c.commentType === 'ALTERNATIVE PRODUCTS');
      const count = ap?.isoforms?.length;
      return count ? `${count} isoforms annotated` : '1 (canonical sequence only)';
    }

    default:
      return null;
  }
}

// ── Protein Atlas field resolvers ──────────────────────────────────────────────
// Data shape from search_download API:
//   { Gene, Ensembl, "RNA tissue specificity": string, "RNA tissue specific nTPM": { tissue: "nTPM_value", … } }
// nTPM thresholds: High > 10, Medium 1–10, Low 0.1–1  (tissues at 0 are unexpressed, skip)
function _fromProteinAtlas(slug, data) {
  const nTPM = data?.['RNA tissue specific nTPM'] ?? {};
  const specificity = data?.['RNA tissue specificity'] ?? '';

  // Sort by expression descending
  const sorted = Object.entries(nTPM)
    .map(([tissue, val]) => [tissue, parseFloat(val)])
    .filter(([, v]) => !isNaN(v) && v > 0)
    .sort(([, a], [, b]) => b - a);

  const high   = sorted.filter(([, v]) => v > 10).map(([t]) => t);
  const medium = sorted.filter(([, v]) => v >= 1 && v <= 10).map(([t]) => t);
  const low    = sorted.filter(([, v]) => v > 0 && v < 1).map(([t]) => t);

  switch (slug) {
    case 'tissue_high':
      if (high.length) return high.slice(0, 6).join(', ');
      // No high-expression tissues — surface the specificity category as context
      if (specificity) return `(none above 10 nTPM — ${specificity})`;
      return '(none)';
    case 'tissue_med':
      if (medium.length) return medium.slice(0, 6).join(', ');
      return '(none)';
    case 'tissue_low':
      if (low.length) return low.slice(0, 6).join(', ');
      return '(none)';
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

// ── Boster scraping resolvers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
function _fromBosterHtml(slug, html, biomarker) {
  switch (slug) {
    case 'wb_image_url': {
      const m = html.match(
        /https:\/\/(?:www\.)?bosterbio\.com\/media\/catalog\/product\/[^"' ]+?(?:wb|western-blot|WB)[^"' ]*?\.(?:jpg|jpeg|png)/i
      );
      return m?.[0] ?? '[WB image not found on Boster gene card]';
    }

    case 'ihc_image_url': {
      const m = html.match(
        /https:\/\/(?:www\.)?bosterbio\.com\/media\/catalog\/product\/[^"' ]+?ihc[^"' ]*?\.(?:jpg|jpeg|png)/i
      );
      return m?.[0] ?? '[IHC image not found on Boster gene card]';
    }

    case 'main_wb_antibody_sku': {
      // Match Boster SKU patterns: PA####, PB####, BA####-##, A#####, M#####
      const m = html.match(/\b(PA\d{3,6}|PB\d{3,6}|BA\d{3,6}(?:-\d+)?|A\d{4,6}|M\d{4,6}(?:-\d+)?)\b/);
      return m?.[1] ?? '[antibody SKU not found]';
    }

    case 'wb_antibody_citations': {
      const m = html.match(/(\d{1,4})\s*(?:citation|publication|paper|reference|cited)/i);
      return m?.[1] ?? '[citation count not found]';
    }

    case 'pub_count': {
      const m = html.match(/(\d{1,4})\s*(?:publication|paper|article|citation)/i);
      return m?.[1] ?? '[publication count not found]';
    }

    case 'assay_apps': {
      const apps = [];
      if (/\bwestern\s*blot\b|\bWB\b/i.test(html)) apps.push('WB');
      if (/\bimmunohistochem|\bIHC\b/i.test(html)) apps.push('IHC');
      if (/\bELISA\b|\benzyme.linked/i.test(html)) apps.push('ELISA');
      if (/\bflow\s*cytom|\bFACS\b|\bFC\b/i.test(html)) apps.push('FC');
      if (/\bimmunofluores|\bIF\b/i.test(html)) apps.push('IF');
      if (/\bimmunoprec|\bIP\b/i.test(html)) apps.push('IP');
      return apps.length ? apps.join(' · ') : '[assay apps not detected]';
    }

    case 'wb_antibody_url': {
      const m = html.match(
        /href="(https:\/\/(?:www\.)?bosterbio\.com\/[^"]+(?:antibod|picoband|PA|PB|BA)[^"]+)"/i
      );
      return m?.[1] ?? `https://www.bosterbio.com/catalogsearch/result/?q=${biomarker}+antibody`;
    }

    default:
      return `[${slug}: not extractable from Boster HTML]`;
  }
}

// ── Computed resolvers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function _computed(slug, biomarker, urlMap, resolved) {
  switch (slug) {
    case 'uniprot_url': {
      const acc = resolved['uniprot_id'] ?? '';
      if (acc && acc !== 'N/A' && !acc.startsWith('[')) {
        return `https://www.uniprot.org/uniprot/${acc}`;
      }
      // Try to extract accession from the REST URL
      const m = (urlMap.uniprot ?? '').match(/\/uniprotkb\/([A-Z0-9]+)/i);
      return m ? `https://www.uniprot.org/uniprot/${m[1]}` : '[uniprot_url: provide uniprot in urlMap]';
    }

    case 'proteinatlas_url': {
      const url = urlMap.proteinatlas ?? '';
      // Strip trailing .json if present (legacy urlMaps), otherwise use as-is
      return url ? url.replace(/\.json$/, '') : `https://www.proteinatlas.org/${biomarker}/tissue`;
    }

    case 'boster_gene_url':
      return urlMap.boster_gene_card ?? `https://www.bosterbio.com/bosterbio-gene-info-cards/${biomarker}`;

    default:
      return null;
  }
}

// ── Main export: hydrateAll ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const UNIPROT_SLUGS = new Set([
  'gene_symbol', 'gene_full_name', 'gene_aliases', 'protein_superfamily', 'uniprot_id',
  'wb_predicted_mw_kda', 'signal_peptide_range', 'ptm_glycosylation_sites',
  'domain_list', 'subcellular_localization', 'isoform_count',
]);
const PA_SLUGS = new Set(['tissue_high', 'tissue_med', 'tissue_low']);
const BOSTER_SLUGS = new Set([
  'wb_image_url', 'ihc_image_url', 'main_wb_antibody_sku', 'wb_antibody_citations',
  'wb_antibody_url', 'pub_count', 'assay_apps',
]);
const COMPUTED_SLUGS = new Set(['uniprot_url', 'proteinatlas_url', 'boster_gene_url']);

/**
 * Resolve a list of slugs to their values in one batched call.
 * Fetches each source at most once; parallelizes UniProt + PA fetches.
 *
 * @param {string[]} slugs  — which slugs to resolve
 * @param {string}   biomarker — gene symbol, e.g. "ADAMTS14"
 * @param {object}   urlMap — { uniprot, proteinatlas, boster_gene_card }
 * @returns {Promise<Record<string, string>>}
 */
export async function hydrateAll(slugs, biomarker, urlMap = {}) {
  const needsUniprot   = slugs.some(s => UNIPROT_SLUGS.has(s));
  const needsPA        = slugs.some(s => PA_SLUGS.has(s));
  const needsBoster    = slugs.some(s => BOSTER_SLUGS.has(s));

  // Parallel fetch all needed sources
  const [uniprotResult, paResult, bosterResult] = await Promise.all([
    needsUniprot && urlMap.uniprot
      ? _fetchJson(urlMap.uniprot, 'UniProt').catch(e => ({ _error: e.message }))
      : Promise.resolve(urlMap.uniprot ? null : { _error: 'uniprot URL not provided' }),
    needsPA
      ? _fetchProteinAtlasTissue(biomarker).catch(e => ({ _error: e.message }))
      : Promise.resolve(null),
    needsBoster
      ? (() => {
          const url = urlMap.boster_gene_card
            ?? `https://www.bosterbio.com/bosterbio-gene-info-cards/${biomarker}`;
          return _fetchHtml(url).catch(e => ({ _htmlError: e.message }));
        })()
      : Promise.resolve(null),
  ]);

  const resolved = {};

  // First pass: all source-backed slugs
  for (const slug of slugs) {
    if (UNIPROT_SLUGS.has(slug)) {
      if (!uniprotResult || uniprotResult?._error) {
        resolved[slug] = `[UniProt error: ${uniprotResult?._error ?? 'no data'}]`;
      } else {
        resolved[slug] = _fromUniProt(slug, uniprotResult) ?? `[${slug}: not found in UniProt]`;
      }
    } else if (PA_SLUGS.has(slug)) {
      if (!paResult || paResult?._error) {
        resolved[slug] = `[ProteinAtlas error: ${paResult?._error ?? 'no data'}]`;
      } else {
        resolved[slug] = _fromProteinAtlas(slug, paResult) ?? `[${slug}: not found in PA]`;
      }
    } else if (BOSTER_SLUGS.has(slug)) {
      if (!bosterResult) {
        resolved[slug] = `[${slug}: Boster fetch skipped]`;
      } else if (bosterResult?._htmlError) {
        resolved[slug] = `[Boster error: ${bosterResult._htmlError}]`;
      } else {
        resolved[slug] = _fromBosterHtml(slug, bosterResult, biomarker);
      }
    }
    // Computed slugs done in second pass
  }

  // Second pass: computed slugs (may reference resolved values)
  for (const slug of slugs) {
    if (COMPUTED_SLUGS.has(slug)) {
      resolved[slug] = _computed(slug, biomarker, urlMap, resolved) ?? `[${slug}: compute failed]`;
    }
  }

  return resolved;
}

/**
 * Resolve a single slug. Convenience wrapper around hydrateAll.
 */
export async function hydrate(slug, biomarker, urlMap = {}) {
  const result = await hydrateAll([slug], biomarker, urlMap);
  return result[slug] ?? `[${slug}: unknown]`;
}

/**
 * Build a standard urlMap from known IDs.
 */
export function buildUrlMap({ uniprotAccession, ensemblId, gene }) {
  const map = {};
  if (uniprotAccession) {
    map.uniprot = `https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/${uniprotAccession}.json`;
  }
  if (ensemblId && gene) {
    // Human-readable browseable URL — tissue data is fetched via search_download API internally
    map.proteinatlas = `https://www.proteinatlas.org/${ensemblId}-${gene}`;
  }
  if (gene) {
    map.boster_gene_card = `https://www.bosterbio.com/bosterbio-gene-info-cards/${gene}`;
  }
  return map;
}

/**
 * All script-hydratable slugs (Phase 1 — no LLM required).
 */
export const SCRIPT_HYDRATABLE_SLUGS = [
  ...UNIPROT_SLUGS, ...PA_SLUGS, ...BOSTER_SLUGS, ...COMPUTED_SLUGS,
];
```

```js
/**

 * Endpoint: https://www.bosterbio.com/?_bapi=1&action=<action>&api_key=<key>
 * Auth: BOSTERBIO_BAPI_KEY env var (or profile env_vars)
 *
 * Actions:
 *   readGenes      — fetch top genes needing enrichment
 *   readGene       — fetch a single gene by gene_species
 *   writeEnrichment — write HTML enrichment back to the genes table
 *   saveProduct    — re-save an existing product (admin-UI-equivalent path)
 *   upsertProduct  — create-or-update a product with full JSON payload (canonical PIM→live write)
 */


export const toc = {
  readGenes: "Read gene records from the live bosterbio.com site.",
  readGene: "Read a single gene record by id from the live bosterbio.com site.",
  writeEnrichment: "Write an enrichment record to the live bosterbio.com site.",
  readCmsPage: "Read a Magento CMS page content by identifier (slug) or page_id via SSH→MySQL.",
  writeCmsPage: "Write/update a Magento CMS page content by identifier (slug) or page_id via SSH→MySQL. Flushes full_page cache after update; call warmPageCache() afterward to avoid Varnish 503.",
  warmPageCache: "Warm a bosterbio.com page in Magento's FPC by hitting nginx:8080 directly with X-Forwarded-Proto:https. Required after writeCmsPage — cold FPC causes Varnish 503s when PHP render exceeds Varnish's first_byte_timeout.",
  saveProduct: "Force one product into the custom CJ search index immediately by running a real Magento ProductRepository save (same path as the admin UI Save button) — skips the multi-minute async wait of the bulk reindexCJSearch.",
  upsertProduct: "Create-or-update one product on the live bosterbio.com Magento site via the upsertProduct BAPI action. Carries the full Magento product payload (title/description/price/status/visibility/attributes/images/categories) as JSON in the POST body. Existing SKU → UPDATE path; new SKU → CREATE path. Returns the entity_id, action taken, and updated_at delta. THIS is the canonical wire for any PIM→live product write — saveProduct() is only a re-save trigger for already-existing products.",
  tickPimWorker: "Ping the live bosterbio.com BAPI to process queued PIM jobs. NO payload — the BAPI handler pulls pending jobs from boster_nexus /pim/jobs/api?action=getJobs and dispatches by job_type (upsert / future types). Returns a summary of processed jobs. This is the canonical 'kick the worker' call after enqueueing.",
  get_products_by_skus: "Retrieve enriched product JSON for 1–100 SKUs via the live BAPI. Each result includes core fields + attributes/images/options/categories. Optional fields[] narrows the response to specific top-level keys.",
  get_products_by_urls: "Resolve product URLs / URL paths / URL keys to enriched product JSON. SQL-resolves URL identity then reuses the same enriched product shape as get_products_by_skus. Optional fields[] applies to the inner product object.",
  lookupProducts: "Unified product lookup by SKU, URL, or EntityID — single ergonomic for callers with mixed-identifier input. Same enricher + same fields[] filter across all three. Products keyed by original input string.",
  get_cms_pages: "Retrieve Magento CMS page records (title, content, meta fields, is_active, stores) for 1–100 identifiers via direct SQL against the cms_page table. Use this instead of re-rolling raw SQL.",
};
import { database } from "@/libs/council/database";
import { execFile } from "node:child_process";
import { promisify } from "node:util";

const execFileAsync = promisify(execFile);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// SSH+MySQL helpers for Magento CMS (boster_production).
// Host/user redacted from source — set BOSTER_PROD_HOST / BOSTER_PROD_USER /
// BOSTER_PROD_PORT in .env.local (see .env.example).
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

const BOSTER_SSH_HOST = process.env.BOSTER_PROD_HOST;
const BOSTER_SSH_USER = process.env.BOSTER_PROD_USER;
const BOSTER_SSH_PORT = process.env.BOSTER_PROD_PORT || "2223";
const MYSQL_HOST = "<REDACTED-IP>";
const MYSQL_USER = process.env.BOSTER_MYSQL_USER || "bosterbio_user";
// SECRET — must be rotated; was previously hardcoded (in git history).
// Resolve from env/formulary ONLY — no literal fallback. Throw on first use if unset.
const MYSQL_PASS = process.env.BOSTERBIO_MYSQL_PASS || process.env.BOSTER_MYSQL_PASS;
const MYSQL_DB = "bosterbio_m2";

/**
 * Run SQL on the remote Magento DB via SSH.
 *
 * The SQL is piped to the remote `mysql` client over SSH **stdin** — it is
 * NEVER inlined into argv. Inlining large SQL (e.g. an UPDATE carrying an
 * ~87KB CMS page body) into the ssh command argument blew past the OS
 * argv-length limit and produced `spawn ENAMETOOLONG`. `mysql` (with no `-e`)
 * reads its statements from stdin natively, so the payload stays off argv
 * entirely and there is no size ceiling.
 *
 * @param {string} sql
 * @returns {Promise<{ ok: boolean, stdout: string, stderr: string }>}
 */
function requireBosterSsh() {
  if (!BOSTER_SSH_HOST || !BOSTER_SSH_USER) {
    throw new Error(
      "Boster production SSH not configured — set BOSTER_PROD_HOST and BOSTER_PROD_USER in .env.local (see .env.example).",
    );
  }
}

function sshMysql(sql) {
  requireBosterSsh();
  if (!MYSQL_PASS) {
    throw new Error(
      "Magento DB password not configured — set BOSTERBIO_MYSQL_PASS (or BOSTER_MYSQL_PASS) in the environment/formulary. The hardcoded literal was removed (rotate the previously committed credential).",
    );
  }
  // Remote command carries NO SQL — only the mysql connection. SQL arrives on stdin.
  const remoteCmd = `mysql -h ${MYSQL_HOST} -u${MYSQL_USER} -p'${MYSQL_PASS}' ${MYSQL_DB}`;
  const args = [
    "-o", "ConnectTimeout=10",
    "-o", "StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new",
    "-o", "BatchMode=yes",
    "-p", BOSTER_SSH_PORT,
    `${BOSTER_SSH_USER}@${BOSTER_SSH_HOST}`,
    remoteCmd,
  ];
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const child = execFile(
      "ssh",
      args,
      { timeout: 30_000, maxBuffer: 5 * 1024 * 1024 },
      (e, stdout, stderr) => {
        if (e) {
          resolve({
            ok: false,
            stdout: (stdout || "").trim(),
            stderr: (stderr || e.message || "").trim(),
          });
        } else {
          resolve({ ok: true, stdout: (stdout || "").trim(), stderr: (stderr || "").trim() });
        }
      },
    );
    // Pipe the (potentially huge) SQL through stdin — keeps it off argv.
    child.stdin.on("error", () => {});
    child.stdin.end(sql.endsWith("\n") ? sql : sql + "\n");
  });
}

const BAPI_BASE = process.env.BOSTERBIO_BAPI_URL || "https://www.bosterbio.com/";

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Auth resolution
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

async function resolveApiKey(userId) {
  const key = process.env.BOSTERBIO_BAPI_KEY;
  if (key) return key;
  if (userId) {
    const db = await database.init("service");
    const { data } = await db
      .from("profiles")
      .select("env_vars")
      .eq("id", userId)
      .single();
    return data?.env_vars?.BOSTERBIO_BAPI_KEY || null;
  }
  return null;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// HTTP helpers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function bapiUrl(action, params = {}) {
  // Clean public form: https://www.bosterbio.com/bapi?action=<name>&<params>&api_key=<key>.
  // The legacy ?_bapi=cjgeo&action=... form still works server-side (pub/index.php
  // shim accepts either) — we emit the clean form for new calls.
  const base = BAPI_BASE.endsWith("/") ? BAPI_BASE : BAPI_BASE + "/";
  const url = new URL("bapi", base);
  url.searchParams.set("action", action);
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(params)) {
    if (v !== undefined && v !== null) url.searchParams.set(k, String(v));
  }
  return url.toString();
}

async function bapiGet(action, params, apiKey, timeoutMs = 15_000) {
  const url = bapiUrl(action, { ...params, api_key: apiKey });
  const res = await fetch(url, {
    headers: { "User-Agent": "GuildOS-Lifecycle/1.0", Accept: "application/json" },
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(timeoutMs),
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`BAPI ${action} HTTP ${res.status}`);
  const json = await res.json();
  if (!json.success) throw new Error(`BAPI ${action} error: ${json.error}`);
  return json;
}

async function bapiPost(action, body, apiKey) {
  const url = bapiUrl(action, { api_key: apiKey });
  const res = await fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded",
      "User-Agent": "GuildOS-Lifecycle/1.0",
      Accept: "application/json",
    },
    body: new URLSearchParams(body).toString(),
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15_000),
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`BAPI ${action} HTTP ${res.status}`);
  const json = await res.json();
  if (!json.success) throw new Error(`BAPI ${action} error: ${json.error}`);
  return json;
}

/**
 * POST a JSON body to a BAPI action. Sibling to bapiPost (which uses
 * form-urlencoded) for actions whose payloads are too large / too nested
 * to express as flat form fields — notably upsertProduct, which carries
 * the full Magento product payload (attributes, images, options, metadata).
 *
 * Default timeout is 60s (vs 15s on bapiGet/bapiPost) because Magento
 * product create/update with media gallery sync can run noticeably longer
 * than a flat attribute read. Callers can override.
 *
 * @param {string} action
 * @param {object} payload — JSON-serializable object; sent as the request body
 * @param {string} apiKey
 * @param {number} [timeoutMs=60000]
 */
async function bapiPostJson(action, payload, apiKey, timeoutMs = 60_000) {
  const url = bapiUrl(action, { api_key: apiKey });
  const res = await fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      "User-Agent": "GuildOS-Lifecycle/1.0",
      Accept: "application/json",
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(payload),
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(timeoutMs),
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`BAPI ${action} HTTP ${res.status}`);
  const json = await res.json();
  if (!json.success) throw new Error(`BAPI ${action} error: ${json.error || "(no error message)"}`);
  return json;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Public actions
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/**
 * Fetch genes that need enrichment (enrichment IS NULL or empty).
 * Ordered by priority DESC.
 *
 * @param {{ limit?: number, species?: string, userId?: string }} opts
 * @returns {Promise<{ ok: boolean, genes: object[] }>}
 */
export async function readGenes({ limit = 5, species = "Human", userId } = {}) {
  const apiKey = await resolveApiKey(userId);
  if (!apiKey) throw new Error("BOSTERBIO_BAPI_KEY not configured");
  const data = await bapiGet("get_genes", { limit, species }, apiKey);
  return { ok: true, genes: data.genes };
}

/**
 * Fetch a single gene record by gene_species key.
 *
 * @param {{ gene_species: string, userId?: string }} opts
 * @returns {Promise<{ ok: boolean, gene: object }>}
 */
export async function readGene({ gene_species, userId } = {}) {
  if (!gene_species) throw new Error("gene_species is required");
  const apiKey = await resolveApiKey(userId);
  if (!apiKey) throw new Error("BOSTERBIO_BAPI_KEY not configured");
  const data = await bapiGet("get_gene", { gene_species }, apiKey);
  return { ok: true, gene: data.gene };
}

/**
 * Write AI-generated HTML enrichment back to a gene record.
 *
 * @param {{ gene_species: string, enrichment_html: string, userId?: string }} opts
 * @returns {Promise<{ ok: boolean, gene_species: string, message: string }>}
 */
export async function writeEnrichment({ gene_species, enrichment_html, userId } = {}) {
  if (!gene_species) throw new Error("gene_species is required");
  if (!enrichment_html) throw new Error("enrichment_html is required");
  const apiKey = await resolveApiKey(userId);
  if (!apiKey) throw new Error("BOSTERBIO_BAPI_KEY not configured");
  const data = await bapiPost("write_enrichment", { gene_species, enrichment_html }, apiKey);
  return { ok: true, gene_species: data.gene_species, message: data.message };
}

/**
 * Force a single product into the custom CJ search index immediately.
 *
 * Runs the `saveProduct` BAPI action, which bootstraps Magento and calls
 * ProductRepositoryInterface::get()+save() in the adminhtml area — the
 * identical save path the admin UI "Save" button uses, so all
 * catalog_product_save_* observers/plugins (incl. the custom CJ search hook)
 * fire. Use this to skip the multi-minute async propagation of the bulk
 * `cj-custom-script?action=reindexCJSearch` reindex for one product.
 *
 * The advancing updated_at (before vs after) confirms the save committed.
 *
 * @param {{ sku: string, userId?: string }} opts
 * @returns {Promise<{ ok: boolean, sku: string, entity_id: number, updated_at_before: string, updated_at_after: string, message: string }>}
 */
export async function saveProduct({ sku, userId } = {}) {
  if (!sku) throw new Error("sku is required");
  const apiKey = await resolveApiKey(userId);
  if (!apiKey) throw new Error("BOSTERBIO_BAPI_KEY not configured");
  // Magento bootstrap + ProductRepository save can run long on a cold app;
  // allow well past the default 15s BAPI timeout.
  const data = await bapiGet("saveProduct", { sku }, apiKey, 90_000);
  return {
    ok: true,
    sku: data.sku,
    entity_id: data.entity_id,
    updated_at_before: data.updated_at_before,
    updated_at_after: data.updated_at_after,
    message: data.message,
  };
}

/**
 * Create-or-update one product on the live bosterbio.com Magento site.
 *
 * This is the canonical wire for any PIM→live product write. The client
 * (push-to-live route) assembles the full Magento payload from pim_products
 * + pim_product_images and POSTs it here; the receiver-side api.phtml handler
 * (operator-authored) tries ProductRepository::get(sku) — on found UPDATEs,
 * on NoSuchEntityException CREATEs via ProductFactory.
 *
 * Wire shape (request body, JSON):
 *   {
 *     sku,                       // required; identity
 *     title, handle,             // url_key on Magento side
 *     description, short_description,
 *     price,                     // numeric
 *     status,                    // 'enabled'|'disabled'|'draft' — receiver maps to Magento int
 *     visibility,                // 'catalog,search'|'catalog'|'search'|'not_visible'
 *     product_template,          // → Magento attribute_set_id
 *     storage, background, immunogen, research_category, source_company,
 *     reactivity[], applications[], badges[], clone, host_species,
 *     target_info{},             // JSONB — gene_name/uniprot_id/etc → custom_attributes
 *     options{}, external_ids{}, metadata{},
 *     attr_1..attr_30,           // sparse — only non-null entries included
 *     images: [{ url, alt_text, position, role }]
 *   }
 *
 * Response shape (normalized):
 *   {
 *     ok: true,
 *     sku,
 *     entity_id,
 *     action: 'created' | 'updated',
 *     updated_at_before,         // null on CREATE
 *     updated_at_after,
 *     message
 *   }
 *
 * Errors (throws): missing api_key, malformed payload, upstream HTTP non-2xx,
 * upstream `{success:false, error}` envelope.
 *
 * Full contract (status/visibility maps, attribute_set_id mapping, images→
 * media_gallery_entries mapping, PHP handler pseudocode):
 *   docs/bapi-upsertProduct-contract.md
 *
 * @param {{ sku: string, payload: object, userId?: string }} opts
 */
/**
 * Ping the live bosterbio.com BAPI to process queued PIM jobs.
 *
 * NO product payload — the BAPI handler pulls pending jobs from boster_nexus
 * `/pim/jobs/api` (action=getJobs, worker='liveSite') and dispatches by
 * job_type (upsert / future types). Returns a summary of processed jobs.
 *
 * This is the canonical "kick the worker" call after enqueueing. Distinct
 * from upsertProduct (which still works for direct single-product writes when
 * a caller wants to bypass the queue).
 *
 * Longer timeout (120s) — the handler may process multiple jobs sequentially
 * before returning.
 *
 * @param {{ userId?: string }} opts
 * @returns {Promise<{ ok: boolean, processed: number, succeeded: number, failed: number, message?: string }>}
 */
export async function tickPimWorker({ userId } = {}) {
  const apiKey = await resolveApiKey(userId);
  if (!apiKey) throw new Error("BOSTERBIO_BAPI_KEY not configured");
  const data = await bapiGet("tickPimWorker", {}, apiKey, 120_000);
  return {
    ok: true,
    processed: data.processed ?? 0,
    succeeded: data.succeeded ?? 0,
    failed: data.failed ?? 0,
    message: data.message,
  };
}

export async function upsertProduct({ sku, payload, userId } = {}) {
  if (!sku || typeof sku !== "string" || !sku.trim()) {
    throw new Error("sku is required (non-empty string)");
  }
  if (!payload || typeof payload !== "object" || Array.isArray(payload) || Object.keys(payload).length === 0) {
    throw new Error("payload is required (non-empty object)");
  }
  const apiKey = await resolveApiKey(userId);
  if (!apiKey) throw new Error("BOSTERBIO_BAPI_KEY not configured");
  // Ensure sku in payload matches the top-level sku (sku is identity).
  const wirePayload = { ...payload, sku };
  // Magento product CREATE with media gallery sync runs longer than UPDATE;
  // 90s budget mirrors saveProduct().
  const data = await bapiPostJson("upsertProduct", wirePayload, apiKey, 90_000);
  return {
    ok: true,
    sku: data.sku,
    entity_id: data.entity_id,
    action: data.action,                 // 'created' | 'updated'
    updated_at_before: data.updated_at_before ?? null,
    updated_at_after: data.updated_at_after,
    message: data.message,
  };
}

/**
 * Retrieve enriched product JSON for 1–100 SKUs via the live BAPI.
 *
 * @param {{ skus?: string[], sku?: string, fields?: string[], userId?: string }} opts
 *   `fields` — optional array of top-level keys to keep on each product
 *   (e.g. `["sku","name","price","product_url"]`). Empty/missing = full enrichment.
 * @returns {Promise<{ success: boolean, action: string, count: number, max_allowed: number, products: object, missing: string[], errors: object[] }>}
 */
export async function get_products_by_skus({ skus, sku, fields, userId } = {}) {
  if (!skus && sku) skus = [sku];
  if (!skus) throw new Error("skus or sku required");
  if (skus.length > 100) throw new Error("skus length exceeds 100");
  const apiKey = await resolveApiKey(userId);
  if (!apiKey) throw new Error("BOSTERBIO_BAPI_KEY not configured");
  const params = { skus: skus.join(",") };
  if (Array.isArray(fields) && fields.length) params.fields = fields.join(",");
  return await bapiGet("get_products_by_skus", params, apiKey, 60_000);
}

/**
 * Resolve product URLs / URL paths / URL keys to enriched product JSON.
 *
 * @param {{ urls?: string[], url?: string, fields?: string[], userId?: string }} opts
 *   `fields` — optional array of top-level keys; applied to the inner `product`
 *   object inside the resolution wrapper (the outer keys — `resolved_sku`,
 *   `matched_path`, `match_method`, `resolved_entity_id` — are unaffected).
 * @returns {Promise<{ success: boolean, action: string, count: number, products: object, not_found: string[], errors: object[] }>}
 */
export async function get_products_by_urls({ urls, url, fields, userId } = {}) {
  if (!urls && url) urls = [url];
  if (!urls) throw new Error("urls or url required");
  if (urls.length > 100) throw new Error("urls length exceeds 100");
  const apiKey = await resolveApiKey(userId);
  if (!apiKey) throw new Error("BOSTERBIO_BAPI_KEY not configured");
  const params = { urls: urls.join(",") };
  if (Array.isArray(fields) && fields.length) params.fields = fields.join(",");
  return await bapiGet("get_products_by_urls", params, apiKey, 60_000);
}

/**
 * Unified product lookup by SKU, URL, or EntityID. Single ergonomic for
 * callers with mixed-identifier input — same enricher + same fields[] filter
 * across all three. Server resolves the identifier type via the `by` param
 * and routes accordingly. Products are keyed by the **original input string**.
 *
 * @param {{
 *   by: ("sku"|"url"|"entity_id"|"id"),
 *   identifiers?: (string|number)[],
 *   identifier?: string|number,
 *   fields?: string[],
 *   userId?: string
 * }} opts
 * @returns {Promise<{
 *   success: boolean, action: "lookupProducts",
 *   by: "sku"|"url"|"entity_id",
 *   count: number, max_allowed: number, fields: string[],
 *   products: object, not_found: string[], errors: object[]
 * }>}
 */
export async function lookupProducts({ by, identifiers, identifier, fields, userId } = {}) {
  if (!by) throw new Error("by required: one of sku|url|entity_id");
  const normBy = String(by).toLowerCase() === "id" ? "entity_id" : String(by).toLowerCase();
  if (!["sku", "url", "entity_id"].includes(normBy)) {
    throw new Error("by must be one of sku|url|entity_id (alias id)");
  }
  if (!identifiers && identifier != null) identifiers = [identifier];
  if (!identifiers || identifiers.length === 0) throw new Error("identifiers required");
  if (identifiers.length > 100) throw new Error("identifiers length exceeds 100");
  const apiKey = await resolveApiKey(userId);
  if (!apiKey) throw new Error("BOSTERBIO_BAPI_KEY not configured");
  const params = { by: normBy, identifiers: identifiers.map(String).join(",") };
  if (Array.isArray(fields) && fields.length) params.fields = fields.join(",");
  return await bapiGet("lookupProducts", params, apiKey, 60_000);
}

/**
 * Retrieve Magento CMS page records (title, content, meta fields, stores) for
 * 1–100 identifiers via direct SQL against the cms_page table.
 *
 * @param {{ identifiers?: string[], identifier?: string, userId?: string }} opts
 * @returns {Promise<{ success: boolean, action: string, count: number, pages: object, missing: string[], errors: object[] }>}
 */
export async function get_cms_pages({ identifiers, identifier, userId } = {}) {
  if (!identifiers && identifier) identifiers = [identifier];
  if (!identifiers) throw new Error("identifiers or identifier required");
  if (identifiers.length > 100) throw new Error("identifiers length exceeds 100");
  const apiKey = await resolveApiKey(userId);
  if (!apiKey) throw new Error("BOSTERBIO_BAPI_KEY not configured");
  return await bapiGet("get_cms_pages", { identifiers: identifiers.join(",") }, apiKey, 30_000);
}

/**
 * Health check — verify BAPI is reachable.
 * @param {{ userId?: string }} opts
 */
export async function ping({ userId } = {}) {
  const apiKey = await resolveApiKey(userId);
  if (!apiKey) throw new Error("BOSTERBIO_BAPI_KEY not configured");
  const url = bapiUrl("ping", { api_key: apiKey });
  const res = await fetch(url, {
    headers: { "User-Agent": "GuildOS-Lifecycle/1.0" },
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8_000),
  });
  const json = await res.json();
  return { ok: json.success === true, message: json.message };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Magento CMS page actions (via SSH → MySQL)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/**
 * Read a Magento CMS page by its identifier (slug) or numeric page_id.
 * @param {{ identifier?: string, page_id?: number }} opts
 * @returns {Promise<{ ok: boolean, page?: object, error?: string }>}
 */
export async function readCmsPage({ identifier, page_id } = {}) {
  if (!identifier && !page_id) throw new Error("identifier or page_id is required");
  const where = page_id ? `page_id = ${Number(page_id)}` : `identifier = '${identifier.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}'`;
  const sql = `SELECT page_id, identifier, title, content, is_active FROM cms_page WHERE ${where} LIMIT 1;`;
  const result = await sshMysql(sql);
  if (!result.ok) return { ok: false, error: result.stderr || "SSH/MySQL error" };
  // Parse tab-separated output (mysql -e returns TSV)
  const lines = result.stdout.split("\n").filter(Boolean);
  if (lines.length < 2) return { ok: false, error: "Page not found" };
  const [headers, ...rows] = lines;
  const cols = headers.split("\t");
  const vals = rows[0].split("\t");
  const page = Object.fromEntries(cols.map((c, i) => [c, vals[i]]));
  return { ok: true, page };
}

/**
 * Write/update a Magento CMS page content by identifier (slug) or page_id.
 * Flushes Magento full-page cache after update.
 * @param {{ identifier?: string, page_id?: number, content: string }} opts
 * @returns {Promise<{ ok: boolean, rows_affected?: number, error?: string }>}
 */
export async function writeCmsPage({ identifier, page_id, content } = {}) {
  if (!identifier && !page_id) throw new Error("identifier or page_id is required");
  if (content === undefined) throw new Error("content is required");
  const where = page_id ? `page_id = ${Number(page_id)}` : `identifier = '${identifier.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}'`;
  // Transit the page body as base64 and decode it server-side with FROM_BASE64().
  // No content quoting/escaping in argv or SQL → no injection surface and no
  // size ceiling (base64 travels over SSH stdin via sshMysql, not argv).
  const contentB64 = Buffer.from(String(content), "utf8").toString("base64");
  const sql = `UPDATE cms_page SET content = CONVERT(FROM_BASE64('${contentB64}') USING utf8mb4) WHERE ${where};`;
  const result = await sshMysql(sql);
  if (!result.ok) return { ok: false, error: result.stderr || "SSH/MySQL error" };
  // Attempt cache flush (non-fatal)
  const magentoRoot = process.env.BOSTER_MAGENTO_ROOT || "<REDACTED-HOST>bosterbio.com/html";
  const flushCmd = `cd ${magentoRoot} && php bin/magento cache:flush full_page config 2>&1 | tail -3`;
  const flushArgs = [
    "-o", "ConnectTimeout=10",
    "-o", "StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new",
    "-o", "BatchMode=yes",
    "-p", BOSTER_SSH_PORT,
    `${BOSTER_SSH_USER}@${BOSTER_SSH_HOST}`,
    flushCmd,
  ];
  const flushResult = await execFileAsync("ssh", flushArgs, { timeout: 60_000 }).catch((e) => ({
    stdout: "",
    stderr: e.stderr || e.message,
  }));
  return {
    ok: true,
    rows_affected: result.stderr.includes("Rows matched") ? 1 : undefined,
    cache_flush: (flushResult.stdout || "").trim() || (flushResult.stderr || "").trim(),
  };
}

/**
 * Warm a page in Magento's Full Page Cache by hitting nginx directly on port 8080.
 * Required after writeCmsPage + cache:flush — cold FPC causes Varnish 503s because
 * PHP render time (10-30s) exceeds Varnish's first_byte_timeout.
 *
 * Simulates the X-Forwarded-Proto:https header that the load balancer normally adds,
 * so Magento renders the HTTPS version of the page (no redirect loop).
 *
 * @param {{ path: string }} opts  e.g. { path: '/workflow-solutions/multiplex-if-solution' }
 * @returns {Promise<{ ok: boolean, status?: number, bytes?: number, error?: string }>}
 */
export async function warmPageCache({ path } = {}) {
  if (!path) throw new Error("path is required");
  const curlCmd = `curl -s -o /tmp/warm_output.html -w '%{http_code} %{size_download} %{time_total}' -H 'Host: www.bosterbio.com' -H 'X-Forwarded-Proto: https' -H 'X-Forwarded-For: <REDACTED-IP>' http://<REDACTED-IP>:8080${path} --max-time 120`;
  const args = [
    "-o", "ConnectTimeout=10",
    "-o", "StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new",
    "-o", "BatchMode=yes",
    "-p", BOSTER_SSH_PORT,
    `${BOSTER_SSH_USER}@${BOSTER_SSH_HOST}`,
    curlCmd,
  ];
  try {
    const { stdout } = await execFileAsync("ssh", args, { timeout: 140_000 });
    const [status, bytes, time] = stdout.trim().split(" ");
    return { ok: parseInt(status) < 400, status: parseInt(status), bytes: parseInt(bytes), time_seconds: parseFloat(time) };
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, error: (e.stderr || e.message || "").trim() };
  }
}
```

```js
/**
 * Browserclaw CDP weapon — headless scraper infrastructure.
 *
 * Use cases (NOT for agent-driven browsing):
 *  - Server-side headless scrapers that run deterministically: `libs/weapon/linkedin`,
 *    `libs/weapon/pubcompare`. These are weapons in the strict sense — no agent in
 *    the loop, scripted selectors, batch execution.
 *  - Not for local Claude's interactive browsing (use Claude-in-Chrome MCP instead).
 *  - Not reachable from cloud Cursor agents (port 9222 is local-only).
 *
 * Architecture: Chrome persistent profile at `~/.guildos-cdp-profile` on port 9222.
 * `ensureCdpChrome()` spawns Chrome if not already running; `executeSteps(steps)` drives it.
 * Auth cookies from `playwright/.auth/user.json` are injected on fresh launch.
 */

import { chromium } from "playwright-core";
import { exec } from "node:child_process";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { homedir } from "node:os";
import { readFileSync, existsSync } from "node:fs";

export const CDP_PORT = 9222;
export const CDP_URL = `http://localhost:${CDP_PORT}`;
export const CDP_PROFILE_DIR =
  process.env.GUILDOS_CDP_PROFILE_DIR ||
  join(homedir(), ".guildos-cdp-profile");
export const AUTH_STATE_PATH =
  process.env.GUILDOS_AUTH_STATE_PATH ||
  join(process.cwd(), "playwright/.auth/user.json");

const STEP_TIMEOUT = 25_000;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Chrome launch helpers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function getChromeExe() {
  if (process.env.CHROME_EXECUTABLE_PATH) return process.env.CHROME_EXECUTABLE_PATH;
  if (process.platform === "win32") {
    return `${process.env.LOCALAPPDATA}\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome.exe`;
  }
  if (process.platform === "darwin") {
    return "/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome";
  }
  return "/usr/local/bin/google-chrome";
}

/**
 * Returns true if CDP Chrome is reachable on port 9222.
 */
export async function isCdpRunning() {
  try {
    const resp = await fetch(`${CDP_URL}/json/version`, {
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(1500),
    });
    return resp.ok;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Inject cookies from playwright/.auth/user.json into the running CDP session.
 * Silently skips if the file doesn't exist.
 */
async function _injectAuthState(authPath = AUTH_STATE_PATH) {
  if (!existsSync(authPath)) return;
  try {
    const { cookies } = JSON.parse(readFileSync(authPath, "utf8"));
    if (!cookies?.length) return;
    const browser = await chromium.connectOverCDP(CDP_URL);
    const ctx = browser.contexts()[0] ?? await browser.newContext();
    await ctx.addCookies(cookies);
    await browser.close();
  } catch {
    // non-fatal — profile cookies may still be valid
  }
}

/**
 * Launch Chrome on port 9222 with the dedicated CDP profile if not already running.
 * No-op if CDP is already reachable. Returns { launched, msg }.
 */
export async function ensureCdpChrome({ profileDir = CDP_PROFILE_DIR } = {}) {
  if (await isCdpRunning()) {
    return { launched: false, msg: "CDP Chrome already running on port 9222" };
  }

  const exe = getChromeExe();
  const flags = [
    `--remote-debugging-port=${CDP_PORT}`,
    `--user-data-dir="${profileDir}"`,
    "--no-first-run",
    "--no-default-browser-check",
    "--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled",
  ].join(" ");

  if (process.platform === "win32") {
    exec(`start "" "${exe}" ${flags}`);
  } else {
    exec(`"${exe}" ${flags} &`);
  }

  // Poll up to 5 seconds for CDP to become reachable
  for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500));
    if (await isCdpRunning()) {
      await _injectAuthState();
      return { launched: true, msg: `CDP Chrome launched on port ${CDP_PORT}` };
    }
  }

  throw new Error(`Chrome launched but CDP not reachable on port ${CDP_PORT} after 5s. Check that Chrome is installed at: ${exe}`);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Step execution
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/**
 * Execute browser steps by connecting to the existing CDP Chrome on port 9222.
 * Does NOT close Chrome — it remains running for subsequent calls.
 *
 * @param {Array<{action: string, item: string, [key: string]: unknown}>} steps
 * @param {{ storageState?: string }} opts
 */
export async function executeSteps(steps, opts = {}) {
  const overallStart = Date.now();
  const stepResults = [];

  const browser = await chromium.connectOverCDP(CDP_URL);

  // Reuse the first existing context (the default CDP context), or create one
  const existingContexts = browser.contexts();
  const context = existingContexts.length > 0
    ? existingContexts[0]
    : await browser.newContext(opts.storageState ? { storageState: opts.storageState } : {});

  const page = await context.newPage();

  try {
    for (let i = 0; i < steps.length; i++) {
      const step = steps[i];
      const stepStart = Date.now();
      let result;
      try {
        result = await executeOneStep(page, step);
      } catch (e) {
        result = { ok: false, error: e.message };
      }
      stepResults.push({
        index: i,
        action: step.action,
        elapsed: Date.now() - stepStart,
        ok: result?.ok ?? false,
        value: result?.value ?? null,
        error: result?.error ?? null,
        ...(step.item ? { item: step.item } : {}),
        ...(result?.buffer ? { buffer: result.buffer } : {}),
      });
      if (!result?.ok) break;
    }
  } finally {
    await page.close().catch(() => {});
    // browser.close() disconnects the Playwright client — Chrome keeps running
    await browser.close().catch(() => {});
  }

  return {
    ok: stepResults.every((r) => r.ok),
    totalElapsed: Date.now() - overallStart,
    steps: stepResults,
  };
}

async function executeOneStep(page, step) {
  const timeout = Math.min(STEP_TIMEOUT, Number(step.timeout) || STEP_TIMEOUT);

  switch (step.action) {
    case "navigate":
      await page.goto(step.url, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded", timeout });
      return { ok: true, value: step.url };

    case "wait": {
      const ms = Math.min(30, Math.max(0, Number(step.seconds) || 1)) * 1000;
      await page.waitForTimeout(ms);
      if (step.selector) {
        await page.waitForSelector(step.selector, { timeout: 30_000 }).catch(() => {});
      }
      return { ok: true, value: `waited ${step.seconds}s` };
    }

    case "typeText": {
      const sel = step.selector || "input";
      await page.waitForSelector(sel, { timeout: 5000 });
      if (step.clearContent !== false) await page.fill(sel, "");
      await page.type(sel, step.text || "", { delay: 30 });
      return { ok: true, value: step.text };
    }

    case "click": {
      const sel = step.selector || "button";
      await page.waitForSelector(sel, { timeout: 5000 });
      await page.click(sel);
      return { ok: true, value: "clicked" };
    }

    case "pressKey": {
      const key = step.key || "Enter";
      if (step.selector) await page.press(step.selector, key);
      else await page.keyboard.press(key);
      return { ok: true, value: `pressed:${key}` };
    }

    case "get":
    case "obtainText": {
      const sel = step.selector || "body";
      await page.waitForSelector(sel, { timeout: 5000 }).catch(() => {});
      if (step.getAll) {
        const values = await page.$$eval(
          sel,
          (els, attr) => els.map((el) =>
            attr && attr !== "innerText"
              ? el.getAttribute(attr) || ""
              : (el.innerText || el.textContent || "").trim()
          ),
          step.attribute || null,
        ).catch(() => []);
        return { ok: true, value: values };
      }
      const attr = step.attribute;
      if (attr && !["innerText", "textContent"].includes(attr)) {
        if (attr === "innerHTML") {
          const h = await page.$eval(sel, (el) => el.innerHTML).catch(() => "");
          return { ok: true, value: h.slice(0, 5000) };
        }
        if (attr === "outerHTML") {
          const h = await page.$eval(sel, (el) => el.outerHTML).catch(() => "");
          return { ok: true, value: h.slice(0, 5000) };
        }
        if (attr === "value") {
          const v = await page.$eval(sel, (el) => el.value || "").catch(() => "");
          return { ok: true, value: v.slice(0, 2000) };
        }
        const v = await page.$eval(sel, (el, a) => el.getAttribute(a) || "", attr).catch(() => "");
        return { ok: true, value: v.slice(0, 2000) };
      }
      const text = await page.$eval(
        sel,
        (el) => el.tagName === "A" ? el.href : (el.innerText || el.textContent || "").trim(),
      ).catch(() => "");
      return { ok: true, value: text.slice(0, 2000) };
    }

    case "obtainHtml": {
      const sel = step.selector || "body";
      await page.waitForSelector(sel, { timeout: 5000 }).catch(() => {});
      const html = await page.$eval(sel, (el) => el.innerHTML).catch(() => "");
      return { ok: true, value: html.slice(0, 5000) };
    }

    case "getUrl":
      return { ok: true, value: page.url() };

    case "getPageInfo": {
      const title = await page.title();
      return { ok: true, value: { title, url: page.url() } };
    }

    case "evaluate": {
      const val = await page.evaluate(step.expression || "document.title");
      return { ok: true, value: typeof val === "string" ? val.slice(0, 2000) : val };
    }

    case "screenshot": {
      const buf = await page.screenshot({
        type: "png",
        fullPage: step.fullPage === true,
        path: step.path || undefined,
      });
      return {
        ok: true,
        value: step.path ? `screenshot saved: ${step.path}` : `screenshot:${buf.length} bytes`,
        ...(step.path ? {} : { buffer: buf }),
      };
    }

    default:
      return { ok: false, error: `Unknown action: ${step.action}` };
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Credential check
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export async function checkCredentials() {
  const running = await isCdpRunning();
  if (!running) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      msg: `CDP Chrome not running on port ${CDP_PORT}. Call ensureCdpChrome() or launch Chrome with --remote-debugging-port=${CDP_PORT} --user-data-dir="${CDP_PROFILE_DIR}"`,
    };
  }
  try {
    const resp = await fetch(`${CDP_URL}/json/version`);
    const info = await resp.json();
    return { ok: true, msg: `CDP Chrome reachable: ${info.Browser || "Chrome"} on port ${CDP_PORT}` };
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, msg: `CDP reachable but version check failed: ${e.message}` };
  }
}
```
