<!-- GUILDOS-FILE: libs/weapon/supabase/index.js -->
```js
/**
 * supabase weapon — Supabase operations.
 *
 * UI-side actions (readTable/readLogs/readAPISettings/readStorageBuckets) drive
 * the Supabase dashboard at app.supabase.com via Browserclaw CDP and PostgREST.
 * The bulkUpload action runs psql \COPY directly against the project's Postgres
 * on port 5432 (NOT the 6543 pooler — \COPY needs the stateful frontend
 * protocol). See libs/skill_book/supabase/index.js → refBulkUploadPattern for
 * the locked discipline.
 *
 * Auth (UI actions): session cookies saved in ~/.guildos-cdp-profile via auth-capture.mjs.
 * Auth (bulkUpload): DB password via env (SUPABASE_DB_URL or SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD + host parts).
 */

export const toc = {
  readTable: "Read rows from a Supabase table via PostgREST.",
  readLogs: "Read Supabase project logs (postgres/auth/realtime/edge-functions) via CDP dashboard.",
  readAPISettings: "Read API URL and keys from the Supabase settings page via CDP.",
  readStorageBuckets: "List storage buckets visible in the Supabase dashboard via CDP.",
  bulkUpload: "Idempotent COPY-based bulk ingest into a Supabase Postgres table via psql + TEMP staging + ON CONFLICT.",
  runSql: "Run arbitrary SQL (incl. DDL: ALTER/CREATE TABLE) against the remote Postgres via the Supabase Management API + a personal access token. The service REST key CANNOT do DDL; this can.",
  applyMigrations: "Apply local supabase/migrations/*.sql files to the remote DB via runSql, then record each version in the schema_migrations ledger (the agent-side equivalent of `supabase db push`).",
  // Skill-book-facing action wrappers: same operations, wrapped in the
  // skillActionOk/Err envelope + (userId, input) arg-normalization the
  // adventurer-execution pipeline expects. The skill book (pure prompt registry)
  // no longer holds these — the registry imports them from here.
  readTableAction: "Enveloped readTable for adventurer execution (skillActionOk/Err).",
  readLogsAction: "Enveloped readLogs for adventurer execution (skillActionOk/Err).",
  readAPISettingsAction: "Enveloped readAPISettings for adventurer execution (skillActionOk/Err).",
  readStorageBucketsAction: "Enveloped readStorageBuckets for adventurer execution (skillActionOk/Err).",
  bulkUploadAction: "Enveloped bulkUpload for adventurer execution (skillActionOk/Err).",
  runSqlAction: "Enveloped runSql for adventurer execution (skillActionOk/Err).",
  applyMigrationsAction: "Enveloped applyMigrations for adventurer execution (skillActionOk/Err).",
};

// Relative (not "@/…") so the weapon still loads under plain node — the
// bulkUpload smoke test imports this module directly without Next alias resolution.
import { skillActionOk, skillActionErr } from "../../skill_book/actionResult.js";

// UI actions (readLogs/readAPISettings/readStorageBuckets) load Browserclaw+playwright
// lazily — bulkUpload doesn't need them, and they pull a Next-aliased import path.
import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync, existsSync, readFileSync, readdirSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const BASE = "https://supabase.com/dashboard";
const MGMT_API = "https://api.supabase.com/v1";

function getAccessToken() {
  const tok = process.env.SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN;
  if (!tok) {
    throw new Error(
      "SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN not set — generate a personal access token at " +
      "https://supabase.com/dashboard/account/tokens and put it in .env.local. See refDdlAndMigrations.",
    );
  }
  return tok;
}

async function getProjectRef(userId) {
  // Default to the project ref from env
  const ref = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL?.match(/https:\/\/([a-z0-9]+)\.supabase\.co/)?.[1];
  if (ref) return ref;
  throw new Error("Cannot determine Supabase project ref from NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL");
}

async function withSupabasePage(fn) {
  const { ensureCdpChrome } = await import("@/libs/weapon/browserclaw/cdp");
  const { chromium } = await import("playwright-core");
  await ensureCdpChrome();
  const browser = await chromium.connectOverCDP("http://localhost:9222");
  const ctx = browser.contexts()[0];
  const page = await ctx.newPage();
  try {
    return await fn(page, browser);
  } finally {
    await page.close();
    await browser.close();
  }
}

async function ensureLoggedIn(page) {
  await page.goto(`${BASE}/projects`, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded", timeout: 20000 });
  await page.waitForTimeout(3000);
  if (page.url().includes("/sign-in") || page.url().includes("/login")) {
    throw new Error("Supabase UI not logged in — run scripts/auth-capture.mjs to capture session");
  }
}

/**
 * Read rows from a table via the Supabase REST API (PostgREST).
 * Navigates the web UI to confirm the table exists; reads data via REST.
 */
export async function readTable({ table, limit = 50, filter } = {}, userId) {
  if (!table) throw new Error('"table" is required');

  const supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
  const serviceKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SECRETE_KEY;
  if (!supabaseUrl || !serviceKey) throw new Error("NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL or SUPABASE_SECRETE_KEY not set");

  let url = `${supabaseUrl}/rest/v1/${table}?limit=${limit}`;
  if (filter) url += `&${filter}`;

  const resp = await fetch(url, {
    headers: {
      apikey: serviceKey,
      Authorization: `Bearer ${serviceKey}`,
      Prefer: "count=exact",
    },
  });
  if (!resp.ok) {
    const text = await resp.text();
    throw new Error(`Supabase readTable ${table} failed (${resp.status}): ${text}`);
  }
  const rows = await resp.json();
  const total = resp.headers.get("content-range")?.split("/")?.[1];
  return { rows, total: total ? Number(total) : undefined };
}

/**
 * Read Supabase project logs from the web UI via CDP.
 * service: "postgres" | "auth" | "realtime" | "edge-functions" | "postgrest"
 */
export async function readLogs({ service = "postgres", limit = 50 } = {}, userId) {
  const ref = await getProjectRef(userId);
  return withSupabasePage(async (page) => {
    await ensureLoggedIn(page);

    const logsUrl = `${BASE}/project/${ref}/logs/${service}`;
    await page.goto(logsUrl, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded", timeout: 20000 });
    await page.waitForTimeout(5000);

    const text = await page.innerText("body").catch(() => "");
    if (text.includes("No logs") || text.includes("no events")) return { logs: [], service };

    // Capture the log API responses
    const logs = [];
    page.on("response", async (resp) => {
      if (resp.url().includes("/logs") && resp.status() === 200) {
        try {
          const ct = resp.headers()["content-type"] || "";
          if (ct.includes("json")) {
            const body = await resp.json().catch(() => null);
            if (body?.result) logs.push(...(body.result || []));
          }
        } catch { /* ignore */ }
      }
    });

    // Reload to capture the log fetch
    await page.reload({ waitUntil: "domcontentloaded", timeout: 20000 });
    await page.waitForTimeout(5000);

    return { logs: logs.slice(0, limit), service };
  });
}

/**
 * Read the project's API settings (URL, anon key, service role key) from the web UI.
 */
export async function readAPISettings({} = {}, userId) {
  const ref = await getProjectRef(userId);
  return withSupabasePage(async (page) => {
    await ensureLoggedIn(page);

    const responses = {};
    page.on("response", async (resp) => {
      if (resp.url().includes("/api-keys") && resp.status() === 200) {
        try {
          const body = await resp.json().catch(() => null);
          if (body) responses.apiKeys = body;
        } catch { /* ignore */ }
      }
    });

    await page.goto(`${BASE}/project/${ref}/settings/api`, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded", timeout: 20000 });
    await page.waitForTimeout(5000);

    const text = await page.innerText("body").catch(() => "");
    return { text: text.slice(0, 2000), apiKeys: responses.apiKeys };
  });
}

/**
 * Read storage buckets from the web UI.
 */
export async function readStorageBuckets({} = {}, userId) {
  const ref = await getProjectRef(userId);
  return withSupabasePage(async (page) => {
    await ensureLoggedIn(page);

    const buckets = [];
    page.on("response", async (resp) => {
      if (resp.url().includes("/storage") && resp.status() === 200) {
        try {
          const ct = resp.headers()["content-type"] || "";
          if (ct.includes("json")) {
            const body = await resp.json().catch(() => null);
            if (Array.isArray(body)) buckets.push(...body);
          }
        } catch { /* ignore */ }
      }
    });

    await page.goto(`${BASE}/project/${ref}/storage/buckets`, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded", timeout: 20000 });
    await page.waitForTimeout(5000);

    return { buckets };
  });
}

export async function checkCredentials(input = {}, userId) {
  try {
    return withSupabasePage(async (page) => {
      await page.goto(`${BASE}/projects`, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded", timeout: 20000 });
      await page.waitForTimeout(3000);
      const url = page.url();
      if (url.includes("/sign-in") || url.includes("/login")) {
        return { ok: false, msg: "Supabase UI not logged in — run scripts/auth-capture.mjs" };
      }
      const text = await page.innerText("body").catch(() => "");
      const hasProjects = text.includes("project") || text.includes("Project");
      return { ok: hasProjects, msg: hasProjects ? "Supabase UI session active" : "Supabase UI loaded but no projects found" };
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, msg: `Supabase UI CDP error: ${e.message}` };
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// bulkUpload — psql \COPY into TEMP staging then INSERT … ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE.
// See libs/skill_book/supabase/index.js → refBulkUploadPattern for the locked
// discipline (port 5432 only, COPY only, TEMP staging only, ON CONFLICT only,
// always return rows_in + affected counts).
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function csvEscape(v) {
  if (v === null || v === undefined) return "";
  let s;
  if (typeof v === "string") s = v;
  else if (typeof v === "number" || typeof v === "boolean") s = String(v);
  else if (v instanceof Date) s = v.toISOString();
  else s = JSON.stringify(v); // objects + arrays → JSON literal (jsonb-friendly)
  if (/[",\r\n]/.test(s)) return `"${s.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
  return s;
}

function buildConnectionUrl() {
  if (process.env.SUPABASE_DB_URL) {
    const u = process.env.SUPABASE_DB_URL;
    // Hard guardrail: refuse pooler port 6543 — \COPY breaks.
    if (/:6543\b/.test(u)) {
      throw new Error(
        "SUPABASE_DB_URL targets pooler port 6543; bulkUpload requires direct port 5432. " +
        "See refBulkUploadPattern."
      );
    }
    return u;
  }
  const host = process.env.SUPABASE_DB_HOST;
  const password = process.env.SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD;
  const user = process.env.SUPABASE_DB_USER || "postgres";
  const port = process.env.SUPABASE_DB_PORT || "5432";
  const db = process.env.SUPABASE_DB_NAME || "postgres";
  if (port === "6543") {
    throw new Error("SUPABASE_DB_PORT=6543 (pooler) — bulkUpload requires 5432.");
  }
  if (!host || !password) {
    throw new Error(
      "bulkUpload: provide connectionUrl, OR SUPABASE_DB_URL, OR SUPABASE_DB_HOST + SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD env."
    );
  }
  return `postgresql://${user}:${encodeURIComponent(password)}@${host}:${port}/${db}`;
}

function quoteIdent(name) {
  if (!/^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$/.test(name)) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid identifier: ${name}`);
  }
  return name;
}

/**
 * bulkUpload — see refBulkUploadPattern.
 *
 * @param {object} input
 * @param {string} input.table
 * @param {object[]} input.rows
 * @param {string[]} input.conflictKeys
 * @param {string} [input.mergeExpr] - SQL fragment for DO UPDATE SET; defaults to overwrite all non-conflict columns
 * @param {string} [input.connectionUrl]
 * @param {boolean} [input.dryRun]
 */
export async function bulkUpload(input = {}, userId) {
  const { table, rows, conflictKeys, mergeExpr, connectionUrl, dryRun = false } = input;
  const start = Date.now();

  if (!table || typeof table !== "string") throw new Error('"table" is required');
  quoteIdent(table);
  if (!Array.isArray(rows) || rows.length === 0) throw new Error('"rows" must be a non-empty array');
  if (!Array.isArray(conflictKeys) || conflictKeys.length === 0) throw new Error('"conflictKeys" is required (no blind inserts)');
  conflictKeys.forEach(quoteIdent);

  const cols = Object.keys(rows[0]);
  if (cols.length === 0) throw new Error("first row has no columns");
  cols.forEach(quoteIdent);
  const colSet = new Set(cols);
  for (const k of conflictKeys) {
    if (!colSet.has(k)) throw new Error(`conflictKey '${k}' missing from row columns`);
  }
  // Validate shape consistency
  for (let i = 1; i < rows.length; i++) {
    const rk = Object.keys(rows[i]);
    if (rk.length !== cols.length || rk.some((k) => !colSet.has(k))) {
      throw new Error(`row ${i} has mismatched keys vs row 0`);
    }
  }

  // Generate CSV
  const ts = Date.now();
  const tmpDir = path.resolve(process.cwd(), "tmp");
  if (!existsSync(tmpDir)) mkdirSync(tmpDir, { recursive: true });
  const csvPath = path.join(tmpDir, `bulk-${table}-${ts}.csv`);
  const headerLine = cols.map(csvEscape).join(",");
  const dataLines = rows.map((r) => cols.map((c) => csvEscape(r[c])).join(","));
  writeFileSync(csvPath, [headerLine, ...dataLines].join("\n") + "\n", "utf8");

  // Build SQL
  const stagingName = `staging_${table}_${ts}`;
  const colList = cols.join(", ");
  const nonConflictCols = cols.filter((c) => !conflictKeys.includes(c));
  const defaultMerge = nonConflictCols.length
    ? nonConflictCols.map((c) => `${c} = EXCLUDED.${c}`).join(", ")
    : null;
  const setClause = mergeExpr || defaultMerge;
  // psql \COPY requires the path on a single line; use forward slashes on Windows for safety.
  const csvPathForPsql = csvPath.replace(/\\/g, "/");

  const onConflictClause = setClause
    ? `ON CONFLICT (${conflictKeys.join(", ")}) DO UPDATE SET ${setClause}`
    : `ON CONFLICT (${conflictKeys.join(", ")}) DO NOTHING`;

  // We split COPY (meta-command, must be on its own line, no semicolon) from the SQL transaction.
  // psql will run the meta-command and then the SQL block.
  const sql = [
    `BEGIN;`,
    `CREATE TEMP TABLE ${stagingName} (LIKE ${table} INCLUDING DEFAULTS);`,
    `\\COPY ${stagingName}(${colList}) FROM '${csvPathForPsql}' WITH (FORMAT csv, HEADER true)`,
    `INSERT INTO ${table} (${colList})`,
    `SELECT ${colList} FROM ${stagingName}`,
    `${onConflictClause};`,
    `COMMIT;`,
  ].join("\n");

  if (dryRun) {
    return { ok: true, dryRun: true, table, rows_in: rows.length, csv_path: csvPath, sql };
  }

  const url = connectionUrl || buildConnectionUrl();

  // Run psql with --single-transaction (covers the file as one tx; our BEGIN/COMMIT is also OK)
  // and ON_ERROR_STOP so any failure aborts.
  // Flags must come BEFORE the dbname argument or psql treats them as filenames.
  // Do NOT pass --quiet — it suppresses the "INSERT 0 N" tag we parse for counts.
  const psqlArgs = [
    "--variable=ON_ERROR_STOP=on",
    "--no-psqlrc",
    "--echo-errors",
    "--file=-",
    "--dbname=" + url,
  ];

  const result = await new Promise((resolve) => {
    const child = spawn("psql", psqlArgs, { stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "pipe"] });
    // UTF-8 decode at the stream level so multibyte chars (β, ×, →, …) split across
    // a pipe boundary aren't mangled into U+FFFD � (see claudecli for the rationale).
    child.stdout.setEncoding("utf8");
    child.stderr.setEncoding("utf8");
    let stdout = "";
    let stderr = "";
    child.stdout.on("data", (d) => { stdout += d.toString(); });
    child.stderr.on("data", (d) => { stderr += d.toString(); });
    child.on("error", (err) => resolve({ code: -1, stdout, stderr: stderr + `\nspawn error: ${err.message}` }));
    child.on("close", (code) => resolve({ code, stdout, stderr }));
    child.stdin.write(sql + "\n");
    child.stdin.end();
  });

  const duration_ms = Date.now() - start;

  if (result.code !== 0) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      error: result.stderr || `psql exited ${result.code}`,
      sql_used: sql,
      csv_path: csvPath,
      stdout: result.stdout,
      duration_ms,
    };
  }

  // Parse INSERT N M — psql emits e.g. "INSERT 0 3"
  let affected = 0;
  const insertMatch = (result.stdout + "\n" + result.stderr).match(/INSERT\s+\d+\s+(\d+)/);
  if (insertMatch) affected = parseInt(insertMatch[1], 10);

  return {
    ok: true,
    table,
    rows_in: rows.length,
    affected,
    csv_path: csvPath,
    duration_ms,
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// runSql / applyMigrations — DDL + migrations via the Supabase Management API.
// The service REST key (PostgREST) CANNOT run DDL; the CLI's `db push` needs a
// DB password AND can't reach the direct host on IPv4-only/quirky networks.
// The Management API SQL endpoint runs arbitrary SQL (incl. ALTER/CREATE TABLE)
// authenticated by a personal access token — no DB password, no direct host.
// See libs/skill_book/supabase/index.js → refDdlAndMigrations.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/**
 * Run arbitrary SQL against the remote Postgres via the Supabase Management API.
 * Handles DDL (ALTER/CREATE) that the service REST key cannot. Returns rows.
 * @param {object} input
 * @param {string} input.sql - one or more statements (`;`-separated allowed)
 */
export async function runSql({ sql } = {}, userId) {
  if (!sql || typeof sql !== "string") throw new Error('"sql" (string) is required');
  const ref = await getProjectRef(userId);
  const tok = getAccessToken();
  const resp = await fetch(`${MGMT_API}/projects/${ref}/database/query`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${tok}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ query: sql }),
  });
  const text = await resp.text();
  if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`Supabase Management API query failed (${resp.status}): ${text}`);
  let rows;
  try { rows = JSON.parse(text); } catch { rows = text; }
  return { ok: true, rows };
}

/**
 * Apply local supabase/migrations/*.sql files to the remote DB via runSql, then
 * record each applied version in supabase_migrations.schema_migrations so the CLI
 * (`supabase db push` / `migration list`) sees them as applied. Agent-side
 * equivalent of `supabase db push`. Migrations MUST be idempotent (IF NOT EXISTS)
 * since this re-runs the file body, not a ledger diff.
 * @param {object} input
 * @param {string[]} [input.versions] - version prefixes (e.g. ["20260612160000"]); omit = all files
 * @param {boolean} [input.record=true] - also write the schema_migrations ledger row
 */
export async function applyMigrations({ versions, record = true } = {}, userId) {
  const dir = path.resolve(process.cwd(), "supabase", "migrations");
  if (!existsSync(dir)) throw new Error(`migrations dir not found: ${dir}`);
  const all = readdirSync(dir).filter((f) => f.endsWith(".sql")).sort();
  const want = Array.isArray(versions) && versions.length ? versions.map(String) : null;
  if (want) {
    for (const v of want) {
      if (!all.some((f) => f.startsWith(v))) throw new Error(`no migration file for version ${v} in ${dir}`);
    }
  }
  const targets = want ? all.filter((f) => want.some((v) => f.startsWith(v))) : all;
  const results = [];
  for (const file of targets) {
    const version = file.match(/^(\d+)/)?.[1];
    const name = file.replace(/^\d+_/, "").replace(/\.sql$/, "");
    const body = readFileSync(path.join(dir, file), "utf8");
    try {
      await runSql({ sql: body }, userId);
      if (record && version) {
        await runSql({
          sql:
            `insert into supabase_migrations.schema_migrations (version, name) ` +
            `values ('${version}', '${name.replace(/'/g, "''")}') on conflict (version) do nothing`,
        }, userId);
      }
      results.push({ file, version, applied: true });
    } catch (e) {
      results.push({ file, version, applied: false, error: e.message });
      break; // stop on first failure — later migrations may depend on this one
    }
  }
  return { ok: results.length > 0 && results.every((r) => r.applied), results };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Skill-book-facing action wrappers.
// These wrap the bare weapon functions above in the standard skillActionOk/Err
// envelope and normalize the (userId, input) call shape used by the adventurer
// execution registry. Moved out of libs/skill_book/supabase/index.js so that
// skill book stays a PURE text-prompt registry (no imports, no functions).
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export async function readTableAction(a, b) {
  const [userId, input] = typeof a === "string" ? [a, b ?? {}] : [undefined, a ?? {}];
  if (!input?.table) return skillActionErr("table required");
  try {
    const data = await readTable({ table: input.table, limit: input.limit, filter: input.filter }, userId);
    return skillActionOk(data);
  } catch (e) { return skillActionErr(e.message); }
}

export async function readLogsAction(a, b) {
  const [userId, input] = typeof a === "string" ? [a, b ?? {}] : [undefined, a ?? {}];
  try {
    const data = await readLogs({ service: input?.service, limit: input?.limit }, userId);
    return skillActionOk(data);
  } catch (e) { return skillActionErr(e.message); }
}

export async function readAPISettingsAction(a, b) {
  const [userId, input] = typeof a === "string" ? [a, b ?? {}] : [undefined, a ?? {}];
  try {
    const data = await readAPISettings({}, userId);
    return skillActionOk(data);
  } catch (e) { return skillActionErr(e.message); }
}

export async function readStorageBucketsAction(a, b) {
  const [userId, input] = typeof a === "string" ? [a, b ?? {}] : [undefined, a ?? {}];
  try {
    const data = await readStorageBuckets({}, userId);
    return skillActionOk(data);
  } catch (e) { return skillActionErr(e.message); }
}

/**
 * bulkUploadAction — enveloped bulkUpload. See libs/skill_book/supabase/index.js
 * → refBulkUploadPattern for the locked discipline.
 */
export async function bulkUploadAction(a, b) {
  const [userId, input] = typeof a === "string" ? [a, b ?? {}] : [undefined, a ?? {}];
  try {
    const data = await bulkUpload(input || {}, userId);
    return data?.ok === false ? skillActionErr(data.error || "bulkUpload failed", data) : skillActionOk(data);
  } catch (e) { return skillActionErr(e.message); }
}

export async function runSqlAction(a, b) {
  const [userId, input] = typeof a === "string" ? [a, b ?? {}] : [undefined, a ?? {}];
  if (!input?.sql) return skillActionErr("sql required");
  try { return skillActionOk(await runSql(input, userId)); }
  catch (e) { return skillActionErr(e.message); }
}

export async function applyMigrationsAction(a, b) {
  const [userId, input] = typeof a === "string" ? [a, b ?? {}] : [undefined, a ?? {}];
  try {
    const data = await applyMigrations(input || {}, userId);
    return data.ok ? skillActionOk(data) : skillActionErr("one or more migrations failed", data);
  } catch (e) { return skillActionErr(e.message); }
}
```

```js
/**
 * Supabase Storage weapon — unified upload/download with path conventions.
 *
 * Auth: Uses SUPABASE_SECRETE_KEY via database service role.
 *
 * Storage convention:
 * - Bucket: GuildOS_Bucket (public)
 * - Path: {channel}/{questId}/{filename} — channel defaults to "general";
 *         cloud agent artifacts use channel="cursor_cloud"
 * - Retention: 30 days (enforced via bucket lifecycle policy or manual cleanup)
 */

export const toc = {
  buildPath: "Build a canonical storage path: {channel}/{questId}/{filename}.",
  writeFile: "Upload a file buffer to Supabase Storage.",
  readPublicUrl: "Get the public URL for a stored file.",
  readFile: "Download a file from Supabase Storage.",
  searchFiles: "Search files in a storage path.",
  deleteFiles: "Delete files from Supabase Storage.",
};
import { database } from "@/libs/council/database";

const DEFAULT_BUCKET = "GuildOS_Bucket";

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Helpers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

async function getClient() {
  return database.init("service");
}

/**
 * Build a standardized storage path.
 * Convention: {channel}/{questId}/{filename}
 * @param {{ channel?: string, questId?: string, filename: string }} input
 */
export function buildPath({ channel = "general", questId, filename }) {
  if (!filename) throw new Error("filename is required");
  const parts = [channel];
  if (questId) parts.push(questId);
  parts.push(filename);
  return parts.join("/");
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Upload
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/**
 * Upload a file to Supabase Storage.
 * @param {{ path: string, content: Buffer|Blob|string, contentType?: string, bucket?: string, upsert?: boolean }} input
 */
export async function writeFile({ path, content, contentType = "application/octet-stream", bucket = DEFAULT_BUCKET, upsert = true } = {}) {
  if (!path) throw new Error("path is required");
  if (!content) throw new Error("content is required");
  const db = await getClient();
  const { data, error } = await db.storage
    .from(bucket)
    .upload(path, content, { contentType, upsert });
  if (error) throw new Error(`Storage upload failed: ${error.message}`);
  return { path: data?.path || path, fullPath: data?.fullPath || path };
}

/**
 * Get the public URL for a stored file.
 * @param {{ path: string, bucket?: string }} input
 */
export function readPublicUrl({ path, bucket = DEFAULT_BUCKET } = {}) {
  const supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
  if (!supabaseUrl) throw new Error("NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL not set");
  return {
    url: `${supabaseUrl}/storage/v1/object/public/${bucket}/${path}`,
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Download
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/**
 * Download a file from Supabase Storage.
 * @param {{ path: string, bucket?: string }} input
 */
export async function readFile({ path, bucket = DEFAULT_BUCKET } = {}) {
  if (!path) throw new Error("path is required");
  const db = await getClient();
  const { data, error } = await db.storage
    .from(bucket)
    .download(path);
  if (error) throw new Error(`Storage download failed: ${error.message}`);
  return { blob: data, path };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// List
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/**
 * List files in a storage path.
 * @param {{ path?: string, bucket?: string, limit?: number }} input
 */
export async function searchFiles({ path = "", bucket = DEFAULT_BUCKET, limit = 100 } = {}) {
  const db = await getClient();
  const { data, error } = await db.storage
    .from(bucket)
    .list(path, { limit, sortBy: { column: "created_at", order: "desc" } });
  if (error) throw new Error(`Storage list failed: ${error.message}`);
  return { files: data || [] };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Delete
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/**
 * Delete files from Supabase Storage.
 * @param {{ paths: string[], bucket?: string }} input
 */
export async function deleteFiles({ paths, bucket = DEFAULT_BUCKET } = {}) {
  if (!Array.isArray(paths) || paths.length === 0) throw new Error("paths array is required");
  const db = await getClient();
  const { error } = await db.storage
    .from(bucket)
    .remove(paths);
  if (error) throw new Error(`Storage delete failed: ${error.message}`);
  return { ok: true, deleted: paths.length };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Credential check
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export async function checkCredentials() {
  try {
    const url = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
    const key = process.env.SUPABASE_SECRETE_KEY;
    if (!url) return { ok: false, msg: "Missing NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL" };
    if (!key) return { ok: false, msg: "Missing SUPABASE_SECRETE_KEY" };
    return { ok: true, msg: "Supabase Storage credentials present" };
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, msg: `Error: ${e.message}` };
  }
}
```

```js
/**
 * Tavily weapon — web search + content extraction.
 *
 * Auth: TVLY_API_KEY env var (or profile env_vars).
 *
 * Used by the biomarker FAQ pipeline for the one-time forum-mining pass that
 * builds the experiment-design question archetype taxonomy (ResearchGate et al.
 * carry real WB troubleshooting Q&A that search-volume signals miss, and they
 * cover the long-tail genes that screen to zero on DataForSEO).
 */

export const toc = {
  search:
    "Tavily web search. Returns ranked {title,url,content} results; supports include_domains to scope to forums (researchgate.net, reddit.com, biostars.org, ...). Use for demand/question mining where search-volume APIs are blind.",
  extract:
    "Tavily extract — pull rendered raw_content for a list of URLs (handles JS pages search/curl can't). Use to read a specific forum thread or product page.",
};

const BASE = "https://api.tavily.com";

async function loadKey(userId) {
  if (userId) {
    try {
      const db = await database.init("service");
      const { data } = await db
        .from("profiles")
        .select("env_vars")
        .eq("id", userId)
        .single();
      const ev = data?.env_vars || {};
      if (ev.TVLY_API_KEY) return ev.TVLY_API_KEY;
    } catch {
      /* fall through */
    }
  }
  return process.env.TVLY_API_KEY || null;
}

/**
 * Web search.
 * @param {{ query: string, include_domains?: string[], exclude_domains?: string[], max_results?: number, search_depth?: "basic"|"advanced", userId?: string }} input
 * @returns {Promise<{ query: string, results: Array<{title:string,url:string,content:string,score:number}> }>}
 */
export async function search(input = {}, userId) {
  const key = await loadKey(userId || input.userId);
  if (!key) throw new Error("TVLY_API_KEY not set");
  const body = {
    query: String(input.query || ""),
    search_depth: input.search_depth || "advanced",
    max_results: input.max_results || 8,
  };
  if (input.include_domains) body.include_domains = input.include_domains;
  if (input.exclude_domains) body.exclude_domains = input.exclude_domains;
  const r = await fetch(`${BASE}/search`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", Authorization: `Bearer ${key}` },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`Tavily HTTP ${r.status}: ${(await r.text()).slice(0, 160)}`);
  const j = await r.json();
  return {
    query: body.query,
    results: (j.results || []).map((x) => ({
      title: x.title,
      url: x.url,
      content: x.content,
      score: x.score,
    })),
  };
}

/**
 * Extract rendered content for URLs.
 * @param {{ urls: string[], userId?: string }} input
 * @returns {Promise<Array<{ url: string, raw_content: string }>>}
 */
export async function extract(input = {}, userId) {
  const key = await loadKey(userId || input.userId);
  if (!key) throw new Error("TVLY_API_KEY not set");
  const urls = (input.urls || []).filter(Boolean);
  if (!urls.length) return [];
  const r = await fetch(`${BASE}/extract`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", Authorization: `Bearer ${key}` },
    body: JSON.stringify({ urls }),
  });
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`Tavily HTTP ${r.status}: ${(await r.text()).slice(0, 160)}`);
  const j = await r.json();
  return (j.results || []).map((x) => ({ url: x.url, raw_content: x.raw_content || "" }));
}
```

```js
/**
 * Telnyx weapon — REST wrapper for the Telnyx programmable-voice / PBX platform.
 *
 * Auth: TELNYX_API_KEY (Bearer) read from profiles.env_vars, fall back to process.env.
 *
 * Optional MCP layer: Telnyx ships an official local MCP server
 * (github.com/team-telnyx/telnyx-mcp-server) runnable via `uvx`. Register it in
 * `~/.claude.json` mcpServers under this project if/when the agent should drive
 * Telnyx via tool calls instead of inline JS. The REST functions below are the
 * primary GuildOS surface — MCP is additive, not required.
 */

export const toc = {
  readBalance: "Read the Telnyx account balance and available credit.",
  searchAvailableNumbers: "Search purchasable DIDs by area code, type, and required features.",
  readNumbers: "Read phone numbers owned by this account.",
  writeNumber: "Purchase a phone number (creates a number order).",
  readOrder: "Read a number order by id (poll status after writeNumber).",
  sendMessage: "Send an SMS from an owned number.",
};
import { database } from "@/libs/council/database";

const BASE = "https://api.telnyx.com/v2";

async function loadKey(userId) {
  if (userId) {
    try {
      const db = await database.init("service");
      const { data } = await db.from("profiles").select("env_vars").eq("id", userId).single();
      const k = data?.env_vars?.TELNYX_API_KEY;
      if (k) return k;
    } catch { /* fall through */ }
  }
  return process.env.TELNYX_API_KEY || null;
}

async function request(path, key, { method = "GET", query, body } = {}) {
  const url = new URL(`${BASE}${path}`);
  if (query) {
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(query)) {
      if (v === undefined || v === null) continue;
      if (Array.isArray(v)) v.forEach((x) => url.searchParams.append(k, String(x)));
      else url.searchParams.set(k, String(v));
    }
  }
  const res = await fetch(url.toString(), {
    method,
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${key}`,
      ...(body ? { "Content-Type": "application/json" } : {}),
    },
    body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
  });
  const text = await res.text();
  const json = text ? (() => { try { return JSON.parse(text); } catch { return text; } })() : null;
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Telnyx ${method} ${path} failed (${res.status}): ${typeof json === "string" ? json : JSON.stringify(json)}`);
  return json;
}

export async function readBalance(input = {}, userId) {
  const key = await loadKey(userId);
  if (!key) throw new Error("TELNYX_API_KEY not set");
  return request("/balance", key);
}

/**
 * @param {{ areaCode?: string, country?: string, type?: "local"|"toll-free"|"national"|"mobile", features?: string[], limit?: number }} input
 *   features: any of voice|sms|mms|fax|emergency|hd_voice
 */
export async function searchAvailableNumbers(input = {}, userId) {
  const key = await loadKey(userId);
  if (!key) throw new Error("TELNYX_API_KEY not set");
  const { areaCode, country = "US", type = "local", features = ["voice"], limit = 10 } = input;
  return request("/available_phone_numbers", key, {
    query: {
      "filter[country_code]": country,
      "filter[phone_number_type]": type,
      ...(areaCode ? { "filter[national_destination_code]": areaCode } : {}),
      "filter[features][]": features,
      "filter[limit]": limit,
    },
  });
}

export async function readNumbers({ limit = 50 } = {}, userId) {
  const key = await loadKey(userId);
  if (!key) throw new Error("TELNYX_API_KEY not set");
  return request("/phone_numbers", key, { query: { "page[size]": limit } });
}

/**
 * Purchase a phone number. Pass exactly one E.164 number (e.g. "+15109732439").
 * Returns the number_order; poll readOrder(id) to confirm status === "success".
 */
export async function writeNumber({ phoneNumber }, userId) {
  if (!phoneNumber) throw new Error('"phoneNumber" is required');
  const key = await loadKey(userId);
  if (!key) throw new Error("TELNYX_API_KEY not set");
  return request("/number_orders", key, {
    method: "POST",
    body: { phone_numbers: [{ phone_number: phoneNumber }] },
  });
}

export async function readOrder({ orderId }, userId) {
  if (!orderId) throw new Error('"orderId" is required');
  const key = await loadKey(userId);
  if (!key) throw new Error("TELNYX_API_KEY not set");
  return request(`/number_orders/${orderId}`, key);
}

export async function sendMessage({ from, to, text, messagingProfileId }, userId) {
  if (!from || !to || !text) throw new Error('"from", "to", "text" are required');
  const key = await loadKey(userId);
  if (!key) throw new Error("TELNYX_API_KEY not set");
  return request("/messages", key, {
    method: "POST",
    body: {
      from,
      to,
      text,
      ...(messagingProfileId ? { messaging_profile_id: messagingProfileId } : {}),
    },
  });
}

export async function checkCredentials(input = {}, userId) {
  const key = await loadKey(userId);
  if (!key) return { ok: false, msg: "TELNYX_API_KEY not set in profiles.env_vars or process.env" };
  try {
    const balance = await request("/balance", key);
    return { ok: true, msg: `Telnyx OK — balance ${balance?.data?.available_credit} ${balance?.data?.currency}` };
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, msg: e.message };
  }
}
```

```js
/**
 * triage weapon — MA's three core orchestration actions.
 *
 * sloganLookup     — resolve ambiguous phrases to skill book actions
 * readSkillBookTocs — read TOCs (descriptions only, howTos stripped)
 * dispatch         — validate fulfillment_plan, assemble SA prompt
 */

import { appendFileSync, mkdirSync } from "fs";
import { SKILL_BOOKS } from "@/libs/skill_book/index.js";

// ── Logger (TEST_MODE only) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

function _log(fn, data) {
  if (!process.env.TEST_MODE) return;
  try {
    mkdirSync("docs/log", { recursive: true });
    const entry = `[${new Date().toISOString()}] ${fn}\n${JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)}\n${"─".repeat(60)}\n`;
    appendFileSync("docs/log/triage.log", entry, "utf8");
  } catch {
    // log failures are silent — never break the main flow
  }
}

// ── sloganLookup ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Resolve ambiguous phrases to skill book actions via 2-tier substring match.
 * No match → askUser:true, MA reasons directly in context.
 *
 * @param {{ phrases: string[] }} opts
 * @returns {Record<string, { matches: Array<{skillBook,action,description}>, tier: 1|2|null, confident: boolean, askUser: boolean, explanation: string }>}
 */
export function sloganLookup({ phrases }) {
  const result = {};

  for (const phrase of phrases) {
    const needle = phrase.toLowerCase().trim();
    let tier1 = [], tier2 = [];

    for (const [id, sb] of Object.entries(SKILL_BOOKS)) {
      if (!sb?.toc) continue;
      for (const [action, entry] of Object.entries(sb.toc)) {
        const desc = typeof entry === "string" ? entry.split("\n")[0].slice(0, 200)
          : typeof entry?.description === "string" ? entry.description : "";
        if (action.toLowerCase().includes(needle))
          tier1.push({ skillBook: id, action, description: desc });
        else if (`${action.toLowerCase()} ${desc.toLowerCase()}`.includes(needle))
          tier2.push({ skillBook: id, action, description: desc });
      }
    }

    if (tier1.length) {
      result[phrase] = { matches: tier1, tier: 1, confident: true, askUser: false,
        explanation: `Matched ${tier1.map(m => `${m.skillBook}.${m.action}`).join(", ")} (tier 1: action name)` };
    } else if (tier2.length) {
      result[phrase] = { matches: tier2, tier: 2, confident: tier2.length <= 3, askUser: false,
        explanation: `Matched ${tier2.map(m => `${m.skillBook}.${m.action}`).join(", ")} (tier 2: name+description)` };
    } else {
      result[phrase] = { matches: [], tier: null, confident: false, askUser: true,
        explanation: `No match for "${phrase}" — MA reasons directly` };
    }
  }

  _log("sloganLookup", { input: phrases, result });
  return result;
}

// ── readSkillBookTocs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Read action names + descriptions for a set of skill books. howTos stripped.
 *
 * @param {{ skillBooks: string[] }} opts
 * @returns {{ tocs: Record<string, Record<string, string>>, warnings: string[] }}
 */
export function readSkillBookTocs({ skillBooks }) {
  const tocs = {}, warnings = [];

  for (const id of skillBooks) {
    const sb = SKILL_BOOKS[id];
    if (!sb?.toc) { warnings.push(`unknown skill book: ${id}`); continue; }
    tocs[id] = {};
    for (const [action, entry] of Object.entries(sb.toc)) {
      tocs[id][action] = typeof entry === "string" ? entry.split("\n")[0].slice(0, 200)
        : typeof entry?.description === "string" ? entry.description : "(no description)";
    }
  }

  _log("readSkillBookTocs", { input: skillBooks, tocs: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(tocs).map(([id, t]) => [id, Object.keys(t)])), warnings });
  return { tocs, warnings };
}

// ── dispatch ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Validate fulfillment_plan in code, assemble SA prompt, return ready for Agent().
 * Hard error if plan missing, malformed, or initiativeId absent — no NL fallback.
 * initiativeId is REQUIRED — GM assigns it, MA passes it through unchanged.
 *
 * @param {{ objective: { objective: string, closing_criteria: string, fulfillment_plan?: { type: string } }, initiativeId: string }} opts
 * @returns {Promise<{ saPrompt: string, warnings: string[], initiativeId: string } | { error: string }>}
 */
// Type → skill books registry. Behavior for each type lives in the listed skill book.
const FULFILLMENT_SKILL_BOOKS = {
  direct_action:    ["localwork"],   // default: covers discussion, self-update, one-shots, CIC
  quest:            ["questmaster"],
  compliance_nudge: ["localwork"],   // transitional — goal is to eliminate
};

export async function dispatch({ objective, initiativeId }) {
  // ── Hard requirement: initiativeId must flow from GM through MA ───────────
  if (!initiativeId || typeof initiativeId !== "string" || !initiativeId.trim()) {
    const err = { error: "DISPATCH_ERROR: initiativeId is required. GM assigns the initiative ID in the dispatch prompt — MA must include it here, never invent one." };
    _log("dispatch", { objective: objective?.objective, result: err });
    return err;
  }

  const plan = objective?.fulfillment_plan;

  if (!plan) {
    const err = { error: "fulfillment_plan missing — complete Clarifying stage before dispatch" };
    _log("dispatch", { objective: objective?.objective, initiativeId, result: err });
    return err;
  }
  if (!plan.type) {
    const err = { error: "fulfillment_plan.type missing — re-enter Clarifying stage" };
    _log("dispatch", { objective: objective?.objective, plan, result: err });
    return err;
  }
  if (!(plan.type in FULFILLMENT_SKILL_BOOKS)) {
    const err = { error: `unknown fulfillment type "${plan.type}" — check fulfillment_types registry in guildmaster skill book` };
    _log("dispatch", { objective: objective?.objective, plan, result: err });
    return err;
  }

  const skillBooks = FULFILLMENT_SKILL_BOOKS[plan.type];
  const { warnings: tocWarnings } = readSkillBookTocs({ skillBooks });
  const { assemblePackage } = await import("../assemblePackage/index.js");
  const r = await assemblePackage({ situation: plan.type });

  const warnings = [...tocWarnings, ...r.warnings];
  const parts = [];
  if (warnings.length) parts.push("## ⚠ Assembly Warnings", warnings.map(w => `- ${w}`).join("\n"), "");
  parts.push(r.prompt.trim(), "", "---", "## Task", objective.closing_criteria.trim());

  const result = { saPrompt: parts.join("\n"), warnings, initiativeId };
  _log("dispatch", {
    objective: objective.objective,
    closing_criteria: objective.closing_criteria,
    plan,
    initiativeId,
    skillBooks,
    assemblePackageSections: r.sections,
    warnings,
    saPrompt: result.saPrompt,
  });
  return result;
}

// ── TOC ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export const toc = {
  sloganLookup:
    "Resolve ambiguous phrases to skill book actions. Input: {phrases: string[]}. Output: map of phrase → {matches, tier, confident, askUser, explanation}. 2-tier: name match → name+desc match. No match → askUser:true, MA reasons directly.",
  readSkillBookTocs:
    "Read action names + descriptions for requested skill books. Input: {skillBooks: string[]}. Output: {tocs: {sbId: {action: description}}, warnings[]}. howTos stripped — MA never sees instructions.",
  dispatch:
    "Validate objective.fulfillment_plan in code, assemble SA prompt, return {saPrompt, warnings, initiativeId} or {error}. Input: {objective, initiativeId}. initiativeId is REQUIRED (GM-assigned) — hard error if missing. Hard error if plan missing or malformed — no NL fallback.",
};
```

```js
/**
 * Vercel weapon — manages deployments, projects, domains, and env vars
 * via the Vercel REST API v9.
 *
 * Auth: VERCEL_API_KEY from profiles.env_vars or process.env.
 */

export const toc = {
  searchProjects: "Search Vercel projects for the team.",
  readProject: "Read a single Vercel project by id.",
  searchDeployments: "Search Vercel deployments for a project.",
  readDeployment: "Read a single Vercel deployment by id.",
  searchDomains: "Search Vercel domains.",
  searchEnvVars: "Search Vercel environment variables for a project.",
  writeEnvVar: "Create or update a Vercel environment variable.",
  redeploy: "Trigger a Vercel redeploy of a project.",
  readUser: "Read the authenticated Vercel user profile.",
  searchTeams: "Search Vercel teams the user belongs to.",
};
import { database } from "@/libs/council/database";

const API_BASE = "https://api.vercel.com";

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Auth
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

async function getApiKey(userId) {
  if (process.env.VERCEL_API_KEY) return process.env.VERCEL_API_KEY;
  if (!userId) return null;
  const db = await database.init("service");
  const { data } = await db
    .from("profiles")
    .select("env_vars")
    .eq("id", userId)
    .single();
  return data?.env_vars?.VERCEL_API_KEY ?? null;
}

async function vercelFetch(path, opts = {}, userId) {
  const token = await getApiKey(userId);
  if (!token) throw new Error("Missing VERCEL_API_KEY");
  const url = path.startsWith("http") ? path : `${API_BASE}${path}`;
  const res = await fetch(url, {
    ...opts,
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      ...opts.headers,
    },
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    const body = await res.text();
    throw new Error(`Vercel API ${res.status}: ${body}`);
  }
  return res.json();
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Projects
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export async function searchProjects({ teamId, limit = 20 } = {}, userId) {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({ limit: String(limit) });
  if (teamId) params.set("teamId", teamId);
  return vercelFetch(`/v9/projects?${params}`, {}, userId);
}

export async function readProject({ projectId, teamId } = {}, userId) {
  if (!projectId) throw new Error("projectId required");
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  if (teamId) params.set("teamId", teamId);
  return vercelFetch(`/v9/projects/${projectId}?${params}`, {}, userId);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Deployments
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export async function searchDeployments(
  { projectId, teamId, limit = 20, state } = {},
  userId,
) {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({ limit: String(limit) });
  if (projectId) params.set("projectId", projectId);
  if (teamId) params.set("teamId", teamId);
  if (state) params.set("state", state);
  return vercelFetch(`/v6/deployments?${params}`, {}, userId);
}

export async function readDeployment({ deploymentId, teamId } = {}, userId) {
  if (!deploymentId) throw new Error("deploymentId required");
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  if (teamId) params.set("teamId", teamId);
  return vercelFetch(`/v13/deployments/${deploymentId}?${params}`, {}, userId);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Domains
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export async function searchDomains({ teamId, limit = 20 } = {}, userId) {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({ limit: String(limit) });
  if (teamId) params.set("teamId", teamId);
  return vercelFetch(`/v5/domains?${params}`, {}, userId);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Environment variables
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export async function searchEnvVars({ projectId, teamId } = {}, userId) {
  if (!projectId) throw new Error("projectId required");
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  if (teamId) params.set("teamId", teamId);
  return vercelFetch(
    `/v9/projects/${projectId}/env?${params}`,
    {},
    userId,
  );
}

export async function writeEnvVar(
  { projectId, teamId, key, value, target = ["production", "preview", "development"], type = "encrypted", upsert = false } = {},
  userId,
) {
  if (!projectId || !key || !value) throw new Error("projectId, key, value required");
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  if (teamId) params.set("teamId", teamId);
  // upsert=true updates an existing var instead of 400-conflicting on create.
  if (upsert) params.set("upsert", "true");
  return vercelFetch(
    `/v10/projects/${projectId}/env?${params}`,
    { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ key, value, target, type }) },
    userId,
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Redeploy
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export async function redeploy({ deploymentId, teamId, target } = {}, userId) {
  if (!deploymentId) throw new Error("deploymentId required");
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  if (teamId) params.set("teamId", teamId);
  const body = {};
  if (target) body.target = target;
  return vercelFetch(
    `/v13/deployments/${deploymentId}/redeploy?${params}`,
    { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(body) },
    userId,
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// User / Team info
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export async function readUser(userId) {
  return vercelFetch("/v2/user", {}, userId);
}

export async function searchTeams({ limit = 20 } = {}, userId) {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({ limit: String(limit) });
  return vercelFetch(`/v2/teams?${params}`, {}, userId);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Credential check (no external call)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export async function checkCredentials(userId) {
  try {
    const key = await getApiKey(userId);
    if (key) {
      return { ok: true, msg: "VERCEL_API_KEY is set" };
    }
    return {
      ok: false,
      msg: "Missing VERCEL_API_KEY — add it to your profile env_vars in Council Hall > Formulary, or set it in .env.local",
    };
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, msg: `Error checking credentials: ${e.message}` };
  }
}
```

```js
/**
 * weaponLog — shared logging utility for all GuildOS weapons.
 *
 * Every weapon call logs itself here. Rolling 500-line window.
 * Who reads this file (GM only vs MA too) is the visibility dial:
 *   - Default: GM reads only → low context pollution
 *   - Debug: MA reads too → full visibility
 *
 * Log format (one entry per call, 4 lines):
 *   --- [ISO] | weapon.function | STATUS ---
 *   AGENT: <agent> | THREAD: <thread>
 *   IN:  <JSON input summary>
 *   OUT: <JSON output summary>
 */

import { readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync } from "fs";
import { join } from "path";

const LOG_PATH = join(process.cwd(), "docs", "weapon-log.md");
const MAX_LINES = 500;

export function logWeaponCall({ weapon, fn, agent = "unknown", thread = "main", input = {}, output = {}, status = "ok" }) {
  try {
    mkdirSync(join(process.cwd(), "docs"), { recursive: true });

    const ts = new Date().toISOString();
    const inSummary = JSON.stringify(input).slice(0, 200);
    const outSummary = JSON.stringify(output).slice(0, 200);

    const entry = [
      `--- [${ts}] | ${weapon}.${fn} | STATUS: ${status} ---`,
      `AGENT: ${agent} | THREAD: ${thread}`,
      `IN:  ${inSummary}`,
      `OUT: ${outSummary}`,
      "",
    ].join("\n");

    // Read existing, prepend new entry, trim to MAX_LINES
    let existing = "";
    try { existing = readFileSync(LOG_PATH, "utf8"); } catch { /* first write */ }

    const lines = (entry + existing).split("\n");
    const trimmed = lines.slice(0, MAX_LINES).join("\n");
    writeFileSync(LOG_PATH, trimmed, "utf8");
  } catch {
    // Log failures are always silent — never break main flow
  }
}

export const toc = {
  logWeaponCall: "Append a weapon call entry to docs/weapon-log.md. Rolling 500-line window. Input: {weapon, fn, agent, thread, input, output, status}. Always silent on failure.",
};
```
